title_zh: 海马冷泉宏基因组来源软骨素酶 A 的底物特异性与功能鉴定
type: 宏基因组来源酶的功能鉴定
scope: Sediments near Haima; a recovered enzyme tested outside the habitat.
海马附近沉积物；功能实验针对重建的酶开展。
design: Characterize a PL8 lyase using defined oligosaccharides, product analysis and site-directed mutagenesis.
采用结构明确的寡糖、产物分析和定点突变，鉴定一种 PL8 裂解酶。
finding: The recovered enzyme selectively cleaved chondroitin/dermatan sulfate motifs containing GalNAc or GalNAc4S; mutagenesis identified residues required for activity.
该酶对含 GalNAc 或 GalNAc4S 的软骨素／皮肤素硫酸基序具有选择性；突变实验识别了活性所必需的残基。
limit: Purified-enzyme specificity does not establish substrate availability, expression or turnover in seep sediments.
纯化酶的特异性不能证明相应底物在冷泉中的供应、酶的表达或原位周转。

title_zh: 亚寒带至热带冷泉沉积物化能自养群落与碳固定潜力的比较
type: 培养实验与比较宏基因组研究
scope: Okhotsk Sea and South China Sea seep sediments; 133 metagenomes spanning 0–240 cm below seafloor.
鄂霍次克海与南海冷泉沉积物；133 个宏基因组覆盖海床下 0–240 cm。
design: Combine dark carbon-fixation incubations with 26 new and 107 public sediment metagenomes.
结合暗碳固定培养实验、26 个新增宏基因组和 107 个公开宏基因组。
finding: Incubated tropical sediments had higher dark carbon-fixation rates than subarctic sediments; carbon-fixation pathway inventories also differed between regions and depths.
培养条件下热带沉积物的暗碳固定速率高于亚寒带沉积物；碳固定途径的基因组成也随区域与深度变化。
limit: Regional comparisons combine environmental and sampling differences; incubated rates are not annual in situ carbon budgets.
区域比较同时包含环境与采样差异；培养速率不能代表年度原位碳收支。

title_zh: 海马贻贝离底回收后鳃共生体系在数小时内的变化
type: Short ex situ holobiont time series
离体短期共生整体时间序列
scope: Gigantidas haimaensis from Haima, maintained at atmospheric pressure.
海马冷泉 Gigantidas haimaensis，在常压条件下暂养。
time: Gill samples at 0, 3 and 9 hours after collection.
采集后 0、3 和 9 小时取鳃样品。
design: Pair 16S amplicons and RNA-seq to track gill bacteria and host transcription during recovery.
结合 16S 扩增子与 RNA-seq，跟踪回收后鳃细菌和宿主转录变化。
finding: Methyloprofundus remained dominant while host transcription changed rapidly; exploratory microbiome–gene associations did not survive false-discovery-rate correction.
Methyloprofundus 始终占优势，宿主转录却迅速变化；探索性的菌群–基因关联未通过错误发现率校正。
limit: Decompression, nutrition and handling covary; the small recovery series cannot identify their separate causal effects.
减压、营养与操作影响同时变化；短期回收序列不能区分各因素的因果效应。

title_zh: 静水压力对冷泉厌氧烃降解群落与代谢策略的影响
type: 控压富集与宏基因组分析
scope: Haima sediment enrichments supplied with n-hexadecane and naphthalene.
添加正十六烷和萘的海马沉积物富集体系。
time: Seven months at 0.1, 5 and 11 MPa.
在 0.1、5 和 11 MPa 下培养七个月。
design: Compare hydrocarbon degradation and MAG pathways across three hydrostatic pressures.
比较三种静水压力下的烃降解及 MAG 代谢途径。
finding: Higher pressure suppressed naphthalene degradation and changed dominant taxa; incomplete pathways in high-pressure Sulfitobacter MAGs suggested metabolic dependence on partner organisms.
较高压力抑制萘降解并改变优势类群；高压 Sulfitobacter MAG 中不完整的途径提示其可能依赖其他微生物。
limit: Partner exchange is inferred from genomes, not directly measured; long enrichments select communities distinct from the initial sediment.
伙伴间物质交换来自基因组推断，并未直接测量；长期富集会筛选出不同于原始沉积物的群落。

title_zh: F 站位贻贝的局地补充与甲烷氧化共生菌的遗传组成
type: 宿主与共生菌种群基因组研究
scope: Gigantidas platifrons at 11 Northwest Pacific sites; six size cohorts and Methyloprofundus symbionts at Site F.
西北太平洋 11 个站位的 Gigantidas platifrons；重点比较 F 站位六个体型组及 Methyloprofundus 共生菌。
design: Compare regional host population structure, local kinship and symbiont genetic variation among size cohorts.
比较区域宿主种群结构、局地亲缘关系及不同体型组的共生菌遗传差异。
finding: Local host kinship declined with distance, whereas Site F methanotrophic symbionts showed low differentiation across host cohorts.
宿主局地亲缘程度随距离降低，而 F 站位甲烷氧化共生菌在不同宿主体型组间的遗传分化较低。
limit: Shell size is not a direct longitudinal record; genetic similarity alone does not demonstrate continuous acquisition from an environmental reservoir.
壳体大小并非直接的纵向观测；遗传相似性本身不能证明共生菌持续从环境菌库获取。

title_zh: 海马沉积物烃利用菌 Stenotrophomonas WO2 的基因组草图
scope: Stenotrophomonas WO2 isolated from Haima sediment using crude oil as sole carbon source.
以原油为唯一碳源从海马沉积物分离的 Stenotrophomonas WO2。
design: Isolate an oil-utilizing strain and assemble its draft genome.
分离可利用原油的菌株并组装基因组草图。
finding: WO2 supplied a 4,772,190-bp draft genome with 66.01% GC content for investigating seep-derived hydrocarbon-utilizing bacteria.
WO2 提供了长 4,772,190 bp、GC 含量为 66.01% 的基因组草图，可用于研究冷泉来源的烃利用细菌。
limit: An isolate genome does not establish environmental abundance, substrate-specific rates or field remediation performance.
单株基因组不能确定环境丰度、特定底物降解速率或现场修复效果。
variables: 基因组大小与 GC 含量

title_zh: DNA 稳定同位素探针揭示冷泉厌氧甲烷氧化的微生物伙伴关系
type: 同位素探针与抑制实验
scope: Haima and Site F sediment intervals at 4–8 cm below seafloor.
海马与 F 站位海床下 4–8 cm 沉积层。
design: Combine DNA-SIP, tracer incubations and bacterial inhibition under different electron-acceptor conditions.
在不同电子受体条件下结合 DNA-SIP、示踪培养及细菌抑制实验。
finding: Methane oxidation persisted as archaeal–bacterial assemblages changed between treatments, supporting metabolic flexibility in the incubated consortia.
在不同处理间古菌–细菌组合变化时，体系仍保持甲烷氧化，支持培养联合体具有代谢灵活性。
limit: Inhibitor effects and isotope incorporation require treatment-specific interpretation; laboratory redundancy is not a measured ecosystem resilience rate.
抑制剂影响与同位素掺入需结合具体处理解释；室内功能冗余不能直接量化生态系统恢复能力。
time: Haima sampling in June 2018 and Site F in June 2021; seven-day microcosms.
海马 2018 年 6 月、F 站位 2021 年 6 月采样；七天微宇宙培养。
locator: Abstract; Sample collection and chemical analysis; SIP microcosms incubations for identification of microbes involved in the AOM.
摘要；Sample collection and chemical analysis；SIP microcosms incubations。

title_zh: 冷泉沉积物来源 Aspergillus 的蒽醌类化合物及细胞实验
scope: Aspergillus SCSIO 41331 from SCS cold-seep sediment.
南海冷泉沉积物来源 Aspergillus SCSIO 41331。
design: Purify metabolites, determine structures by NMR and mass spectrometry, and assay tumor-cell proliferation.
分离代谢产物，采用 NMR 和质谱解析结构，并开展肿瘤细胞增殖实验。
finding: New anthraquinone-related metabolites were characterized; one assayed compound inhibited HT29 proliferation and colony growth in vitro.
研究鉴定了新的蒽醌相关代谢物；其中一种受测化合物在体外抑制 HT29 细胞增殖及集落形成。
limit: Cell-line activity is neither a clinical efficacy result nor evidence of the compounds' ecological role at seeps.
细胞系活性既不代表临床疗效，也不能证明这些化合物在冷泉中的生态作用。

title_zh: 南海冷泉沉积物两种 Salegentibacter 新种的多相分类
scope: Sediment isolates F14T and HM20T from South China Sea cold seeps.
南海冷泉沉积物分离株 F14T 与 HM20T。
design: Combine growth phenotypes, chemotaxonomy, phylogenomics and genome similarity comparisons.
结合生长表型、化学分类、系统基因组及基因组相似度分析。
finding: The two facultatively anaerobic isolates met the study's criteria for Salegentibacter profundi and S. haimaensis, with distinct tested growth ranges.
两株兼性厌氧菌符合研究中新种 Salegentibacter profundi 与 S. haimaensis 的划分标准，受测生长范围不同。
limit: Culture growth ranges describe these isolates and do not establish abundance or ecological dominance in situ.
培养生长范围仅适用于这两株菌，不能确定其原位丰度或生态优势。
variables: 生长范围与基因组相似度

title_zh: 海马冷泉 PVC 与聚碳酸酯潜在降解菌的富集与分布
scope: Haima cold-seep plastic enrichments and environmental water/sediment comparisons.
海马冷泉塑料富集体系及环境水体、沉积物比较。
time: One-year in situ incubation followed by 189-day laboratory enrichment.
一年原位培养及 189 天室内富集。
design: Incubate PVC and polycarbonate films, inspect surface changes and track bacterial amplicon variants.
培养 PVC 和聚碳酸酯膜，检查表面变化并跟踪细菌扩增子变体。
finding: Plastic-associated enrichments grew and altered film surfaces; abundance changes identified candidate degraders, with candidate signals more abundant in seawater than sediment.
塑料相关富集群落可生长并改变膜表面；丰度变化识别出候选降解菌，其信号在海水中高于沉积物。
limit: Candidate ASVs and surface damage do not individually prove polymer mineralization or quantify natural removal rates.
候选 ASV 与表面损伤本身不能证明聚合物完全矿化，也不能量化天然去除速率。
variables: 膜表面变化与富集生长

title_zh: 海马冷泉氧化还原梯度上的卤代有机物与脱卤微生物
type: 非靶向化学分析与宏基因组剖面
scope: A 500-cm Haima sediment core across redox zones.
跨氧化还原分区的一支 500 cm 海马沉积物岩芯。
design: Combine non-target chemical formula assignments, sediment geochemistry and metagenomic dehalogenase profiles.
结合非靶向分子式鉴定、沉积物地球化学与宏基因组脱卤酶分析。
finding: The study detected 669 halogenated molecular formulas; organochlorine signals declined near a redox boundary and covaried with chemistry and dehalogenase inventories.
研究检出 669 个含卤分子式；有机氯信号在氧化还原边界附近降低，并与化学条件及脱卤酶基因组成共变。
limit: Formula-level assignments do not resolve every chemical structure; correlations cannot separate microbial removal from burial and transport.
分子式层面鉴定不能解析全部化学结构；相关性不能区分微生物去除、埋藏和输运。

title_zh: 海马沉积物产甲烷古菌的垂向分层与烷烃相关代谢潜力
type: 岩芯宏基因组与烷烃富集
scope: A 5-m Haima core including the sulfate–methane transition; enrichment inoculum at 350 cm below seafloor.
包含硫酸盐–甲烷转换带的 5 m 海马岩芯；富集接种物取自海床下 350 cm。
time: Ten-month anaerobic C10/C16 alkane enrichment.
十个月厌氧 C10／C16 烷烃富集。
design: Combine geochemistry, mcrA qPCR, 21 mcrA-bearing MAGs and alkane enrichments.
结合地球化学、mcrA 定量 PCR、21 个含 mcrA 的 MAG 及烷烃富集。
finding: mcrA signals increased within/below the transition zone; alkane loss accompanied acetate accumulation, consistent with a possible substrate link to acetoclastic methanogenesis.
mcrA 信号在转换带内及下方升高；烷烃减少伴随乙酸积累，与向乙酸营养型产甲烷供底物的可能联系一致。
limit: Acetate accumulation and pathway genes do not directly trace alkane carbon into methane or prove the proposed syntrophic exchange.
乙酸积累和途径基因不能直接追踪烷烃碳进入甲烷，也不能证明所提出的互营交换。
variables: mcrA 丰度与 MAG 途径

title_zh: 海马冷泉水平生境异质性与原核群落组装及共现模式
scope: Haima seepage and faunal sediment habitats.
海马渗漏区及大型动物相关沉积物生境。
design: Measure sediment geochemistry and 16S composition; estimate assembly and co-occurrence patterns.
测量沉积物地球化学与 16S 群落组成，估计组装过程和共现模式。
finding: The seepage habitat had lower alpha diversity and distinct archaeal composition; modeled bacterial and archaeal assembly differed across habitats.
渗漏生境的 α 多样性较低，古菌组成不同；模型估计的细菌和古菌组装过程随生境变化。
limit: Assembly models and co-occurrence edges describe statistical patterns, not demonstrated microbial interactions or causal environmental controls.
组装模型与共现边表示统计模式，并非已证实的微生物相互作用或环境因果控制。

title_zh: 氨基酸与氨基糖揭示海马冷泉沉积物有机质加工特征
type: 有机质生物标志物剖面
scope: Three Haima sediment cores with methane-rich and methane-poor intervals.
三支海马沉积物岩芯，包含富甲烷和贫甲烷层位。
design: Quantify amino acids and amino sugars and calculate degradation and microbial-source indices.
定量氨基酸、氨基糖，并计算降解指数和微生物来源指标。
finding: Biomarker indices indicated degraded organic matter; methane-rich layers had lower amino-acid concentrations and source estimates suggested substantial fungal-derived carbon.
生物标志物指数指示有机质降解程度较高；富甲烷层氨基酸较少，来源估计提示真菌来源碳具有一定贡献。
limit: Source fractions depend on biomarker assumptions; the profiles do not directly measure fungal biomass production or AOM-driven degradation rates.
来源比例依赖生物标志物假设；剖面未直接测量真菌生物量生产或 AOM 驱动的降解速率。

title_zh: 海马冷泉木质素分布及微生物酶促转化潜力
type: 木质素富集与多组学研究
scope: Haima sediment horizons, laboratory enrichments and genomic comparisons across 12 seep systems.
海马沉积层、室内富集，以及十二个冷泉系统的基因组比较。
design: Profile lignin and enrich communities with lignin as carbon substrate, then examine depolymerization and aromatic-processing genes.
分析木质素，以其为碳源富集群落，并检查解聚和芳香族中间产物处理基因。
finding: Lignin enrichment selected distinct bacterial communities and implicated multiple enzyme pathways for polymer breakdown and aromatic processing; direct methanogenesis was not detected.
木质素富集筛选出不同的细菌群落，多种酶途径参与聚合物分解和芳香族产物处理；未检出直接产甲烷。
limit: Genetic methylotrophic potential is not measured methane production, and enrichment turnover cannot establish a regional carbon sink.
甲基营养遗传潜力不等于测得甲烷产生；富集周转不能确定区域碳汇规模。

title_zh: 南海冷泉 Lysinibacillus WB86 完整基因组与次级代谢潜力
type: 分离菌基因组与生物合成预测
scope: Lysinibacillus WB86 isolated from an SCS cold seep.
南海冷泉分离株 Lysinibacillus WB86。
design: Sequence a circular chromosome with Oxford Nanopore and predict biosynthetic gene clusters.
利用 Oxford Nanopore 测序获得环状染色体，并预测生物合成基因簇。
finding: The 4.54-Mb genome contained eight predicted biosynthetic clusters, including a candidate lanthipeptide cluster.
约 4.54 Mb 的基因组含八个预测生物合成基因簇，包括一个候选羊毛硫肽基因簇。
limit: Cluster prediction does not establish production, chemical novelty or antimicrobial activity of the encoded products.
基因簇预测不能证明产物实际生成、化学新颖性或抗菌活性。
variables: genome structure and predicted biosynthetic clusters
基因组结构与预测生物合成基因簇

title_zh: 培养与非培养方法揭示南海冷泉微生物生物合成潜力
type: 培养与环境生物合成潜力调查
scope: Reductive and non-reductive SCS cold-seep sediments and their cultured isolates.
南海冷泉还原性、非还原性沉积物及分离菌株。
design: Combine 16S amplicons, microbial isolation, metagenomics and biosynthetic-cluster prediction.
结合 16S 扩增子、微生物分离、宏基因组与生物合成基因簇预测。
finding: Sediment types differed in community and biosynthetic-cluster profiles; cultivable communities were enriched in Firmicutes and did not mirror all environmental diversity.
沉积物类型间群落和生物合成基因簇组成不同；可培养群落富集 Firmicutes，不能反映全部环境多样性。
limit: Amplicon-based cluster estimates and metagenomic predictions require chemical or expression validation before claims of product synthesis.
基于扩增子或宏基因组的基因簇预测，需化学或表达验证后才能认定产物合成。
variables: 群落组成与生物合成基因簇目录

title_zh: 海马渗漏区与非渗漏区微生物垂向变化和组装过程
scope: Seepage and non-seepage sediment profiles at Haima.
海马渗漏区与非渗漏区沉积物剖面。
design: Compare archaeal, bacterial and eukaryotic marker profiles, gene copies and ecological assembly estimates.
比较古菌、细菌和真核标记剖面、基因拷贝数及生态组装估计。
finding: Seepage profiles had more archaeal/bacterial gene copies and depth-specific lineages; assembly models indicated stronger homogeneous selection for prokaryotes and drift-dominated eukaryotic assembly.
渗漏剖面的古菌／细菌基因拷贝数及深度特异类群较多；模型指示原核群落受较强同质选择，真核群落更受漂变影响。
limit: Model-assigned processes are not directly observed dispersal or selection; ANME–SRB co-occurrence does not prove partner-specific AOM.
模型分配的过程不是直接观测的扩散或选择；ANME–SRB 共现不能证明特定伙伴间的 AOM。
variables: 标记基因拷贝数与深度分布

title_zh: 贻贝鳃来源 Arcobacter iocasae 新种的分类与生理特征
scope: Strain KX21116T from Gigantidas platifrons gill homogenate at an SCS seep.
南海冷泉 Gigantidas platifrons 鳃匀浆分离株 KX21116T。
design: Compare physiology, chemotaxonomy, phylogenomics, ANI and digital DNA–DNA hybridization.
比较生理、化学分类、系统基因组、ANI 与数字 DNA–DNA 杂交值。
finding: The strain represented the proposed Arcobacter iocasae species and grew aerobically and microaerobically under tested conditions.
该菌株代表所提出的 Arcobacter iocasae 新种，在受测条件下可好氧和微需氧生长。
limit: Isolation from gill homogenate does not establish an obligate symbiont, benefit to the host or natural population abundance.
从鳃匀浆分离并不能证明其为专性共生菌、有益于宿主或具有某种天然丰度。
variables: 生长生理与基因组相似度

title_zh: 海马冷泉不同发育阶段的病毒多样性与辅助代谢基因
type: 发育阶段比较病毒宏基因组学
scope: Chemoautotrophic, mature and extinct Haima seep sediment habitats.
海马化能自养阶段、成熟阶段与衰亡冷泉沉积物生境。
design: Recover viral units from sediment metagenomes and infer hosts, lifestyles and auxiliary metabolic genes.
从沉积物宏基因组重建病毒单元，推断宿主、生活方式及辅助代谢基因。
finding: The catalogue contained 4,272 viral units; diversity and predicted metabolic repertoires differed among seep stages, with the highest diversity in the chemoautotrophic stage.
目录包含 4,272 个病毒单元；多样性与预测代谢组成随冷泉阶段变化，化能自养阶段的多样性最高。
limit: Host links, lifestyles and AMGs are computational inferences; cross-site stages are not a repeated time series or measured viral carbon flux.
宿主联系、生活方式和 AMG 来自计算推断；不同站位的阶段比较并非重复时间序列，也未测量病毒介导碳通量。

title_zh: 海马芽孢杆菌新种的生理特征与生物合成基因组潜力
type: 分离菌分类与比较基因组
scope: Bacillus haimaensis CSS-39T from Haima sediments at 1,350-m water depth.
水深 1,350 m 海马沉积物来源 Bacillus haimaensis CSS-39T。
design: Combine cultivation phenotypes, complete-genome sequencing and comparisons with related Bacillus.
结合培养表型、完整基因组测序及与近缘 Bacillus 的比较。
finding: Genomic and phenotypic evidence supported a new species; six predicted biosynthetic clusters included a candidate lassopeptide cluster.
基因组和表型证据支持划分新种；六个预测生物合成基因簇中包括候选套索肽基因簇。
limit: Predicted biosynthesis and stress genes do not demonstrate product activity or adaptation under native high-pressure conditions.
预测生物合成和胁迫基因不能证明产物活性或天然高压条件下的适应机制。
variables: 分离株表型与基因组比较

title_zh: 冷泉碳酸盐中黑碳的来源及微生物贡献估计
scope: Seep carbonates from the South China Sea and Gulf of Mexico.
南海与墨西哥湾冷泉碳酸盐。
design: Analyze black-carbon chemistry and isotopes and estimate source fractions with a Bayesian mixing model.
分析黑碳化学与同位素组成，并采用贝叶斯混合模型估计来源比例。
finding: Depleted black-carbon carbon isotopes were consistent with a methane-related source; the model assigned a 2–33% microbial contribution in the analyzed carbonates.
黑碳碳同位素亏损与甲烷相关来源一致；模型估计受测碳酸盐中微生物来源贡献为 2–33%。
limit: Source assignments depend on isotope endmembers; carbonate storage cannot directly establish the global dissolved-black-carbon flux.
来源划分依赖同位素端元；碳酸盐储存量不能直接确定全球溶解黑碳通量。

title_zh: 浅海贻贝暴露于深海冷泉后的转录与微生物群落响应
scope: Mytilus galloprovincialis transferred to Site F cold seep.
移入 F 站位冷泉的 Mytilus galloprovincialis。
time: Ten-day deep-sea exposure.
十天深海暴露。
design: Compare host transcriptomes and associated microbiomes during exposure to seep conditions.
比较冷泉暴露期间宿主转录组与相关微生物群落。
finding: Exposed mussels acquired a microbiome richer in methanotrophs alongside host stress, immune and metabolic transcriptional changes.
暴露贻贝的菌群中甲烷氧化菌增多，同时出现宿主胁迫、免疫与代谢转录变化。
limit: Short exposure and host–microbe correlations do not demonstrate evolutionary adaptation or a stable nutritional symbiosis.
短期暴露及宿主–微生物相关性不能证明进化适应或稳定的营养共生。
variables: 宿主转录与微生物组成

title_zh: 不同微塑料对海马冷泉微生物群落及功能潜力的影响
scope: Haima seawater and sediment laboratory cultures.
海马海水与沉积物室内培养体系。
time: Two-month culture series.
两个月培养序列。
design: Compare plastic-associated and surrounding communities with environmental chemistry and microbial genetic profiles.
结合环境化学和微生物遗传分析，比较塑料表面与周围环境群落。
finding: Culture time and original habitat shaped plastic-associated communities, whose inferred network structure and nitrogen/methane functions differed from environmental communities.
培养时间和原始生境影响塑料表面群落，其推断的网络结构及氮／甲烷功能不同于环境群落。
limit: Network fragility and predicted functions are not measured ecosystem instability, pathogen risk or in situ nutrient fluxes.
网络脆弱性和预测功能不等于测得的生态系统不稳定性、病原风险或原位营养盐通量。

title_zh: F 站位冷泉碳酸盐中的空间异质性与微生物代谢潜力
type: 碳酸盐生境多方法比较
scope: Eight Site F carbonates from lobster, mussel and low-activity habitats, with sediment/water comparisons.
F 站位铠甲虾区、贻贝区及低活性生境的八件碳酸盐样品，并与沉积物／水体比较。
time: ROV Faxian sampling in 2021.
2021 年 Faxian ROV 采样。
design: Combine interface sensors, carbonate imaging, metagenomics, qPCR and 13CH4 labeling; seep activity classes use habitat/geochemical proxies.
结合界面传感、碳酸盐成像、宏基因组、定量 PCR 与 13CH4 标记；活动等级依据生境及地球化学代理指标划分。
finding: Active lobster-zone carbonates favored ANME-2c while mussel-zone carbonates favored ANME-1b; low-activity carbonate communities differed and more closely resembled nearby water.
活跃铠甲虾区碳酸盐偏富集 ANME-2c，贻贝区偏富集 ANME-1b；低活性碳酸盐群落不同，且更接近附近水体。
limit: Activity rankings are proxy based; proposed mineral self-sealing does not quantify long-term methane permeability changes.
活动等级基于代理指标；提出的矿物自封闭过程不能量化长期甲烷渗透性变化。
locator: Sampling; Geochemical conditions of the sampling sites; Microbiome community structure of carbonate samples based on PhyloFlash.
Sampling；采样点地球化学条件；基于 PhyloFlash 的碳酸盐微生物群落结构。

title_zh: 海马六种底栖动物鳃相关菌群的宿主特异性
scope: Six benthic invertebrates from heterogeneous Haima habitats.
海马异质生境中的六种底栖无脊椎动物。
design: Compare bacterial composition, histological/subcellular localization and predicted gill-microbiome functions.
比较细菌组成、组织／亚细胞定位与鳃菌群预测功能。
finding: Mussel and clam gills had relatively simple intracellular symbiont communities, whereas the other examined hosts carried more complex extracellular assemblages.
贻贝和蛤鳃内共生菌群较简单，其他受测宿主的胞外相关群落更复杂。
limit: Host specificity and predicted functions do not independently demonstrate host selection mechanisms or fitness benefits.
宿主特异性与预测功能不能单独证明宿主选择机制或适合度收益。
variables: gill community composition and cellular location
鳃群落组成及细胞定位

title_zh: 南永安东脊管虫体内及周围环境的冷泉微生物
type: Tubeworm symbiont and habitat marker survey
管虫共生菌与生境标记基因调查
scope: Paraescarpia formosa and its habitat at South Yungan East Ridge, southwest of Taiwan.
台湾西南南永安东脊 Paraescarpia formosa 及其生境。
design: Use a trunk 16S clone library and full-length environmental 16S amplicons.
采用管虫躯干 16S 克隆文库及环境全长 16S 扩增子。
finding: The trunk library contained one dominant symbiont phylotype; surrounding habitats included ANME-1b and abundant sulfur-oxidizing lineages.
躯干部位文库含一个主要共生菌系统型；周围生境包含 ANME-1b 和丰富的硫氧化类群。
limit: Marker genes describe membership; they do not identify metabolite transfer or demonstrate specific ANME–SRB partnerships.
标记基因描述成员组成，不能识别代谢物转移或证明特定 ANME–SRB 伙伴关系。
variables: 宿主及生境 16S 系统型

title_zh: 模拟海马冷泉条件下甲烷渗漏与微塑料老化
scope: Haima sediment and seawater in 200-mL reactors.
200 mL 反应器中的海马沉积物与海水。
time: Two months; four plastic types at approximately 10% concentration.
两个月；四种塑料，浓度约 10%。
design: Compare plastic surface chemistry, roughness, colonization and nutrient changes under simulated seep conditions.
在模拟渗漏条件下比较塑料表面化学、粗糙度、微生物定殖和营养盐变化。
finding: Stronger simulated seepage accelerated measured surface aging, particularly for PLA and sediment treatments, alongside changes in inorganic nutrients.
较强模拟渗漏加速测得的表面老化，PLA 与沉积物处理尤为明显，并伴随无机营养盐变化。
limit: High plastic loading and reactor conditions limit environmental extrapolation; surface aging is distinct from complete biodegradation.
高塑料负荷与反应器条件限制环境外推；表面老化不同于完全生物降解。

title_zh: 深海沉积物全长与短读长 16S 测序的分辨率比较
scope: Surface sediment core from the Shenhu cold-seep area off the Pearl River Estuary.
珠江口外神狐冷泉区域表层沉积物岩芯。
design: Compare PacBio full-length and Illumina short-read 16S profiles on sediment samples.
对沉积物样品比较 PacBio 全长与 Illumina 短读长 16S 分析。
finding: PacBio profiles yielded more classified taxa, especially at species level, and resolved additional fine-scale community differences.
PacBio 分析获得更多可分类类群，种水平尤为明显，并分辨出更多细尺度群落差异。
limit: Database, primer and pipeline choices affect platform comparisons; improved marker resolution does not provide metabolic or strain-level validation.
数据库、引物与流程选择影响平台比较；标记分辨率提高不能替代代谢或菌株水平验证。

title_zh: 海马冷泉水体与沉积物原核群落及有机营养物添加响应
type: 水体–沉积物调查与溶解有机物添加
scope: Five Haima stations; surface to 1,350–1,450-m bottom water and surface sediment.
海马五个站位；表层至 1,350–1,450 m 底层水及表层沉积物。
time: May 2021 sampling; 48-hour bottle incubations.
2021 年 5 月采样；48 小时瓶培养。
design: Collect CTD water and ROV sediment, then compare communities and bottle additions of urea, ATP, dibenzothiophene and glucose at controlled temperatures.
采集 CTD 水样与 ROV 沉积物，比较群落，并在控温瓶中添加尿素、ATP、二苯并噻吩及葡萄糖。
finding: Bottom-water communities more closely resembled other water layers than sediments; different organic nutrient additions enriched different bacterial orders.
底层水群落与其他水层的相似性高于与沉积物的相似性；不同有机营养物添加富集不同细菌目。
limit: These were temperature-controlled bottle responses; substrate addition and metagenomic potential do not quantify natural elemental fluxes.
这些结果为控温瓶培养响应；底物添加和宏基因组潜力不能量化天然元素通量。
variables: 群落相似性的深度变化
locator: Abstract; Sample collection; DOM enrichment experiments.
摘要；Sample collection；DOM enrichment experiments。

title_zh: 冷泉候选细菌门 Effluviviacota 的系统基因组与代谢潜力
type: 未培养类群比较基因组学
scope: Thirty MAGs from SCS and other seeps plus Guaymas hydrothermal sediments.
来自南海等冷泉及 Guaymas 热液沉积物的三十个 MAG。
design: Use phylogenomics and metabolic reconstruction to characterize a candidate phylum and its genera.
采用系统基因组与代谢重建分析候选门及其属级类群。
finding: Effluviviacota genomes encoded fermentative carbohydrate/peptide use and candidate extracellular electron-transfer systems, with differences among genera.
Effluviviacota 基因组编码碳水化合物／肽发酵利用及候选胞外电子传递系统，不同属间存在差异。
limit: Incomplete MAGs and annotation cannot establish growth substrates, electron acceptors or actual in situ reaction rates.
不完整 MAG 与功能注释不能确定实际生长底物、电子受体或原位反应速率。
variables: MAG 系统发育与途径目录

title_zh: 海马冷泉 Hwangdonia lutea 新种的分类鉴定
scope: Aerobic strain SCSIO 19198T from Haima sediment.
海马沉积物好氧分离株 SCSIO 19198T。
design: Compare growth traits, cellular chemistry, 16S phylogeny and genome similarity.
比较生长特征、细胞化学、16S 系统发育与基因组相似度。
finding: The isolate was assigned to Hwangdonia lutea; its genome similarity to H. seohaensis was below the study's species thresholds.
该分离株被划为 Hwangdonia lutea；与 H. seohaensis 的基因组相似度低于研究采用的种划分阈值。
limit: Taxonomic and culture evidence does not establish its abundance, activity or ecological role in undisturbed sediment.
分类和培养证据不能确定其在未扰动沉积物中的丰度、活性或生态作用。
variables: 分离株生长与基因组相似度

title_zh: 南海冷泉水体新属新种 Fontisubflavum oceani
scope: Aerobic strain CSW1921T isolated from SCS deep-sea cold-seep water.
南海深海冷泉水体好氧分离株 CSW1921T。
design: Combine physiology, chemotaxonomy and genome comparisons with related Rhodobacteraceae.
结合生理、化学分类及与近缘 Rhodobacteraceae 的基因组比较。
finding: The 3.59-Mb isolate genome and polyphasic evidence supported the proposed new genus and species Fontisubflavum oceani.
约 3.59 Mb 的分离株基因组及多相证据支持提出新属新种 Fontisubflavum oceani。
limit: A cultured water isolate does not establish pelagic dominance or methane oxidation capability.
培养获得的水体分离株不能证明其在水体占优势或具有甲烷氧化能力。
variables: 基因组相似度与生长特征

title_zh: REMIRGE 揭示冷泉功能基因的细尺度系统发育多样性
type: 功能基因重建方法研究
scope: Five seep sites and a non-seep comparison, including centimeter-scale Haima profiles.
五个冷泉与一个非冷泉对照，包括海马厘米尺度剖面。
design: Reconstruct full-length functional genes from shotgun reads with REMIRGE and compare phylogenetic clusters.
利用 REMIRGE 从宏基因组读段重建全长功能基因，比较系统发育簇。
finding: Methane-, sulfur- and nitrogen-related gene clusters differed among sites and sediment depths, revealing variation obscured by conventional functional summaries.
甲烷、硫和氮相关基因簇随站位及沉积深度变化，揭示常规功能汇总难以分辨的差异。
limit: Gene phylogeny improves potential-function resolution but correlated clusters do not prove metabolic coupling or flux.
基因系统发育提高潜在功能分辨率，但相关基因簇不能证明代谢耦合或通量。
variables: 基因多样性的深度变化

title_zh: 海马不同生境沉积物的矿物组合与微生物群落
scope: Haima methane-seep, faunal and control sediment habitats.
海马甲烷渗漏、动物聚集及对照沉积物生境。
design: Compare mineral assemblages, bacterial/archaeal profiles and sediment chemistry.
比较矿物组合、细菌／古菌组成及沉积物化学。
finding: Seep sediments contained abundant calcite and distinct microbial assemblages; sulfate, calcium and magnesium covaried with minerals and bacteria.
渗漏沉积物含丰富方解石及不同的微生物组合；硫酸盐、钙、镁与矿物及细菌组成共变。
limit: Mineral–community correlations do not measure mineral precipitation rates or prove a specific microbial precipitation mechanism.
矿物–群落相关性不能测量矿物沉淀速率或证明特定微生物沉淀机制。
variables: 矿物组合与微生物组成

title_zh: 南海冷泉古菌脂质组多样性及甲烷氧化代理指标
type: 古菌标记基因–脂质比较
scope: SCS sediments differing in methane supply.
甲烷供应不同的南海沉积物。
design: Pair 16S profiles with 55 core/intact-polar lipid types and porewater carbon chemistry.
结合 16S 组成、55 种核心／完整极性脂质及孔隙水碳化学。
finding: Lipid inventories and archaeal communities differed with seepage; intact-polar lipid indices correlated with ANME distributions and methane-related geochemistry.
脂质组成和古菌群落随渗漏条件变化；完整极性脂质指数与 ANME 分布及甲烷相关地球化学有关。
limit: Lipid preservation and multiple producers complicate attribution; proxy indices are not direct ANME activity measurements.
脂质保存及多来源生产增加归因难度；代理指数并非 ANME 活性的直接测量。

title_zh: 冷泉厌氧菌 Abyssisolibacter M8S5 的代谢与适应基因
type: 厌氧分离菌基因组分析
scope: Abyssisolibacter M8S5 from SCS seep sediment at 1,151-m water depth.
水深 1,151 m 南海冷泉沉积物来源 Abyssisolibacter M8S5。
design: Analyze a complete isolate genome for substrate pathways, extracellular enzymes and stress-related genes.
分析完整分离株基因组中的底物途径、胞外酶与胁迫相关基因。
finding: M8S5 encoded diverse carbohydrate/peptide-use pathways, anaerobic respiratory genes and incomplete histidine/proline biosynthesis.
M8S5 编码多种碳水化合物／肽利用途径与厌氧呼吸基因，而组氨酸／脯氨酸合成途径不完整。
limit: Genome annotation alone cannot prove strict amino-acid dependence or functional adaptation to pressure and temperature.
基因组注释本身不能证明严格的氨基酸依赖或对压力、温度的功能适应。
variables: 底物利用与生物合成基因

title_zh: 海马动物聚集区环境异质性与碳硫循环相关菌群
type: 动物生境地球化学与组学比较
scope: Four faunal-aggregate habitats at Haima.
海马四类动物聚集生境。
design: Combine geochemistry, meta-omics and association networks among sediment microorganisms.
结合沉积物地球化学、组学及微生物关联网络。
finding: ANME, sulfate reducers and sulfur oxidizers differed across aggregates, with aggregate-specific network patterns and sulfate/calcium associations.
ANME、硫酸盐还原菌及硫氧化菌在聚集区间不同，网络模式及硫酸盐／钙关联具有生境特异性。
limit: Correlated communities and chemistry cannot separate fluid supply, animal effects and microbial feedbacks causally.
群落与化学相关性不能因果区分流体供应、动物影响及微生物反馈。
variables: 群落网络与沉积物化学

title_zh: 海马冷泉沉积物微型真核生物多样性与寄生类群
type: 微型真核生物垂向调查
scope: Active, less-active and non-seep Haima cores, 0–25 cm sediment depth.
海马活跃、较低活跃与非冷泉岩芯，沉积深度 0–25 cm。
design: Analyze 18S composition, diversity, phylogeny and ecological assembly models.
分析 18S 组成、多样性、系统发育及生态组装模型。
finding: Seep habitats had greater regional microeukaryotic diversity and more parasitic-lineage indicators, including Apicomplexa and Syndiniales.
冷泉生境的区域微型真核多样性较高，包含 Apicomplexa 和 Syndiniales 等更多寄生类群指示信号。
limit: 18S affiliation does not demonstrate infection or identify actual hosts; assembly effects are statistically inferred.
18S 分类归属不能证明感染或识别实际宿主；组装效应来自统计推断。
variables: 18S 多样性与寄生类群指标

title_zh: 海马冷泉孔隙水易利用含硫溶解有机物的分子证据
type: 孔隙水光学与分子化学
scope: Haima seep sediments and nearby non-seep reference sediments.
海马冷泉及附近非冷泉对照沉积物。
design: Compare DOM optical properties, molecular formulas and composition-based lability indices.
比较溶解有机物光学性质、分子式及基于组成的易利用性指数。
finding: Seep porewater had more protein-like fluorescence, sulfur-bearing formulas and molecular indicators of relatively labile DOM than reference sediments.
与对照相比，冷泉孔隙水具有更多类蛋白荧光、含硫分子式及相对易利用 DOM 的分子指标。
limit: Optical/molecular lability proxies are not direct biodegradation assays; biotic and abiotic sulfurization were not fully separated.
光学／分子易利用性指标并非直接生物降解实验；生物与非生物硫化尚未完全区分。

title_zh: 南海冷泉与西沙海槽表层沉积物甲烷循环菌群的生物地理
scope: 0–4 cm surface sediments at Site F, Haima and the Xisha trough.
F 站位、海马与西沙海槽 0–4 cm 表层沉积物。
design: Compare 16S profiles, methane/sulfate-cycle marker abundance and phylogeny with geochemistry.
结合地球化学比较 16S 组成、甲烷／硫酸盐循环标记丰度及系统发育。
finding: Sites formed distinct microbial clusters; cold-seep sediments had more functional-marker copies, while NC10 relative abundance was higher in the trough.
站位形成不同微生物簇；冷泉沉积物功能标记拷贝较多，而海槽 NC10 相对丰度较高。
limit: Marker similarity to known DAMO organisms cannot quantify nitrate/nitrite-dependent methane oxidation or identify its actual contribution.
与已知 DAMO 生物的标记相似性不能量化硝酸盐／亚硝酸盐依赖甲烷氧化或其实际贡献。
variables: 功能标记拷贝数与基因型

title_zh: 海马衰亡冷泉微生物的碳氮硫代谢潜力
type: 衰亡冷泉群落与代谢分析
scope: Extinct Haima sediment with active-seep and non-seep comparisons.
海马衰亡冷泉沉积物，并与活跃冷泉及非冷泉比较。
design: Compare prokaryotic diversity, association networks and inferred metabolic pathways.
比较原核多样性、关联网络及推断代谢途径。
finding: The extinct seep retained distinctive bacterial assemblages and diverse carbon, nitrogen and sulfur metabolic potential despite cessation of visible seep activity.
可见渗漏活动停止后，衰亡冷泉仍保留独特细菌组合及多种碳、氮、硫代谢潜力。
limit: Cross-site comparisons do not follow ecosystem decline through time; pathway inventories cannot measure continuing primary production.
跨站位比较未连续追踪生态衰退；途径目录不能测量持续的初级生产。
variables: 原核多样性与代谢目录

title_zh: 琼东南热成因水合物沉积层的微生物垂向分布
type: 含水合物岩芯微生物调查
scope: Qiongdongnan core spanning hydrate-bearing and hydrate-free layers.
琼东南包含含水合物及无水合物层的岩芯。
design: Pair 16S amplicons and molecular/geochemical measurements across hydrate occurrences.
结合 16S 扩增子及分子／地球化学测量，比较不同水合物赋存层。
finding: Hydrate-bearing layers had higher microbial abundance but lower diversity, and archaeal composition changed sharply along the core.
含水合物层微生物丰度较高而多样性较低，古菌组成沿岩芯明显变化。
limit: Hydrate occurrence covaries with sediment properties; functional roles inferred from taxonomy require direct tests.
水合物赋存与沉积物性质共同变化；从分类推断的功能需直接检验。
variables: 微生物丰度与水合物分层

title_zh: 海马沉积物可培养石油降解菌及烷烃利用特征
type: 石油降解联合体与分离株实验
scope: Five enriched consortia and bacterial isolates from Haima sediments.
海马沉积物来源五个富集联合体及细菌分离株。
design: Enrich oil-utilizing communities and test isolate growth and oil/alkane degradation.
富集石油利用群落，测试分离株生长及石油／烷烃降解。
finding: Seven isolates degraded oil in laboratory tests; degradation differed between crude oil, diesel and alkane chain-length classes.
七株分离菌在室内实验中降解石油，原油、柴油及不同链长烷烃的降解表现不同。
limit: Enrichment performance does not establish survival, removal rates or remediation effectiveness at native deep-sea pressure.
富集性能不能证明天然深海压力下的存活、去除速率或修复效果。

title_zh: 冷泉硫酸盐还原菌通过硫代硫酸盐代谢生成零价硫
type: 分离株生理与酶学验证
scope: Oceanidesulfovibrio marinus CS1 isolated from SCS seep sediment.
南海冷泉沉积物分离株 Oceanidesulfovibrio marinus CS1。
design: Combine culture sulfur measurements, proteomics, enzyme assays and in situ expression observations.
结合培养硫测量、蛋白组、酶实验及原位培养表达观测。
finding: CS1 produced zero-valent sulfur from thiosulfate; PhsA reduction followed by SQR-mediated sulfide oxidation supported the tested pathway.
CS1 可由硫代硫酸盐产生零价硫；PhsA 还原后经 SQR 氧化硫化物的证据支持受测途径。
limit: Homologous genes in sediment do not quantify the community-wide contribution of this isolate pathway to sulfur cycling.
沉积物中的同源基因不能量化这一分离株途径对整体硫循环的贡献。
variables: 硫产物与 PhsA／SQR 活性

title_zh: F 站位冷泉沉积物微生物的水平与垂向异质性
type: 细尺度沉积物群落调查
scope: 0–24 cm cores at southern/northern reduced sediments and two Site F controls.
F 站位南部／北部还原沉积物与两个对照的 0–24 cm 岩芯。
design: Compare 16S profiles and environmental gradients at four locations and multiple depths.
比较四个位置、多个深度的 16S 组成与环境梯度。
finding: Southern and northern reduced sediments differed in ANME clades and sulfate-reducer assemblages, with proposed transition zones near 8 and 10 cm, respectively.
南北还原沉积物的 ANME 分支及硫酸盐还原菌组合不同，推定转换带分别约为 8 和 10 cm。
limit: Proposed transition depths and co-occurrence are source-specific; marker data do not determine AOM rates or prove syntrophy.
推定转换深度与共现模式限于该研究；标记数据不能确定 AOM 速率或证明互营。
variables: 深度特异类群与沉积物化学

title_zh: 海洋四号冷泉岩芯完整极性及核心四醚脂质指标
scope: Core 973-5 from the Haiyang 4 cold-seep area.
海洋四号冷泉区 973-5 岩芯。
design: Analyze intact-polar and core GDGT fractions separately along the sediment profile.
沿沉积剖面分别分析完整极性和核心 GDGT 脂质。
finding: Lipid indices shifted in the sulfate–methane transition, consistent with changing contributions from methane-related and ammonia-oxidizing archaea.
硫酸盐–甲烷转换带脂质指数发生变化，与甲烷相关及氨氧化古菌贡献改变相符。
limit: Lipid-source assignments and preservation differ among fractions; ratios are not direct measurements of living biomass or metabolic rates.
不同脂质组分的来源划分和保存不同；比值并非活体生物量或代谢速率的直接测量。
variables: 核心及完整极性 GDGT 比值

title_zh: 南海冷泉双壳类脂质标志物及共生营养来源
type: 宿主–共生菌脂质同位素比较
scope: Four mussel/clam species from Site F and Haima.
F 站位与海马四种贻贝／蛤。
design: Analyze tissue lipids and compound-specific carbon isotopes to compare nutritional sources.
分析组织脂质及化合物特异碳同位素，比较营养来源。
finding: Methanotroph-hosting and thiotroph-hosting bivalves had distinct lipid signatures; matching host/symbiont isotope patterns supported substantial symbiont-derived nutrition.
甲烷氧化与硫氧化共生双壳类的脂质特征不同；宿主／共生菌相近同位素模式支持较大的共生营养贡献。
limit: Biomarkers infer source contributions; they do not directly measure contemporaneous carbon-transfer rates or ambient oxygen.
标志物推断来源贡献，未直接测量同步碳转移速率或环境氧浓度。
variables: tissue lipid profiles and carbon isotopes
组织脂质组成与碳同位素

title_zh: 南海冷泉沉积物六类自养碳固定途径的宏基因组潜力
scope: Sediments from two SCS cold seeps and one trough.
南海两个冷泉与一个海槽的沉积物。
design: Reconstruct carbon-fixation pathways from metagenomes and MAGs across sediment depths.
由宏基因组和 MAG 重建不同沉积深度的碳固定途径。
finding: Genes representing six carbon-fixation pathways were detected; rTCA was widespread and Wood–Ljungdahl pathway genes were concentrated in seep sediments.
检出代表六类碳固定途径的基因；rTCA 分布广泛，Wood–Ljungdahl 途径基因主要集中于冷泉沉积物。
limit: Gene presence and completeness do not establish pathway direction, expression or quantitative carbon-fixation contribution.
基因存在及完整性不能确定途径方向、表达或碳固定的定量贡献。
variables: 碳固定基因与 MAG 途径

title_zh: 南海冷泉与海槽沉积物微型真核生物的生物地理
type: 微型真核标记与网络调查
scope: Two northern SCS cold seeps and one trough.
南海北部两个冷泉与一个海槽。
design: Use 18S amplicons and network analysis to compare microbial eukaryote composition.
利用 18S 扩增子与网络分析比较微型真核组成。
finding: SAR lineages dominated; seep communities differed from the trough and contained many lineages related to parasitic or symbiotic taxa.
SAR 类群占优势；冷泉群落不同于海槽，并包含许多与寄生或共生类群相关的谱系。
limit: Sequence affiliation and network correlations cannot identify actual trophic relationships or distinguish living cells from deposited DNA.
序列归属及网络相关性不能识别实际营养关系，也不能区分活细胞与沉积 DNA。

title_zh: 福尔摩沙冷泉细菌–古菌协同将甘氨酸甜菜碱转化为甲烷
type: 沉积物微宇宙与重建共培养
scope: Formosa seep sediment and isolated Oceanirhabdus/Methanococcoides strains.
福尔摩沙冷泉沉积物及分离的 Oceanirhabdus／Methanococcoides 菌株。
design: Combine substrate amendments, inhibition, metagenomics, strain isolation and defined cocultures at 18°C and 4°C.
结合底物添加、抑制、宏基因组、菌株分离及 18°C、4°C 的明确共培养体系。
finding: A bacterial–archaeal coculture converted glycine betaine to methane; dimethylglycine addition was required for the tested 4°C coculture.
细菌–古菌共培养可将甘氨酸甜菜碱转化为甲烷；受测 4°C 共培养需添加二甲基甘氨酸。
limit: The demonstrated route does not establish glycine betaine as the dominant methane precursor throughout natural seep sediments.
已验证的途径不能确定甘氨酸甜菜碱是天然冷泉沉积物中占主导的甲烷前体。

title_zh: 贻贝宿主、内共生菌与表生菌的硫化物胁迫响应
type: 冷泉–热液比较与硫化物暴露
scope: Gigantidas platifrons from Formosa Ridge and Iheya North Knoll.
福尔摩沙海脊及伊平屋北丘来源 Gigantidas platifrons。
time: Three-day laboratory sulfide treatment.
三天室内硫化物处理。
design: Compare 16S and host/microbial transcription, then test mussel responses to Na2S exposure.
比较 16S 及宿主／微生物转录，再检验贻贝对 Na2S 暴露的响应。
finding: Seep–vent differences and sulfide exposure involved host and symbiont sulfur-oxidation transcripts, including sqr, consistent with multiple detoxification components.
冷泉–热液差异及硫化物暴露涉及宿主与共生菌的硫氧化转录变化，包括 sqr，与多组分解毒机制一致。
limit: Transcriptional responses do not independently quantify detoxification flux or prove each partner's necessity.
转录响应不能独立量化解毒通量，也不能证明每个伙伴的必要性。
variables: 硫氧化及宿主胁迫转录信号

title_zh: 古菌分类标记 aCPSF1 及南海冷泉样品验证
scope: Global archaeal genomes and an SCS cold-seep sample used for marker comparison.
全球古菌基因组及用于标记比较的南海冷泉样品。
design: Compare aCPSF1 phylogeny against 16S and phylogenomics, including a matched environmental diversity survey.
将 aCPSF1 系统发育与 16S、系统基因组比较，并在同一环境样品中比较多样性。
finding: aCPSF1 clustering broadly agreed with established archaeal phylogenies and gave finer lower-rank resolution; the seep comparison produced similar diversity patterns.
aCPSF1 聚类总体与既有古菌系统发育一致，低分类阶元分辨率更高；冷泉样品比较获得相近多样性模式。
limit: One environmental validation does not establish universal primer coverage or equivalent quantitative abundance across archaeal lineages.
单个环境验证不能确定普适引物覆盖度或不同古菌类群间等效的定量丰度。
variables: 标记系统发育与分类分辨率

title_zh: 海马孔隙水类蛋白溶解有机碳与甲烷氧化的联系
type: 孔隙水同位素与光学剖面
scope: Two Haima seep cores and a nearby reference core.
两支海马冷泉岩芯及附近一支对照岩芯。
design: Measure sulfate, DOC concentration, DOC carbon isotopes and fluorescence components.
测量硫酸盐、DOC 浓度、DOC 碳同位素及荧光组分。
finding: Seep porewater had high DOC and strongly depleted carbon isotopes, together with more protein-like fluorescence, supporting a methane-related DOC contribution.
冷泉孔隙水 DOC 较高、碳同位素明显亏损，且类蛋白荧光较多，支持存在甲烷相关 DOC 贡献。
limit: Isotope/fluorescence proxies do not directly quantify methane-to-DOC production, microbial uptake or export into the ocean.
同位素／荧光代理不能直接量化甲烷向 DOC 的转化、微生物摄取或向海洋输出。

title_zh: 冷泉厌氧菌 Iocasia 的多糖降解与发酵产物
type: 厌氧分离菌生理与转录分析
scope: Iocasia fonsfrigidae NS-1 from an SCS deep-sea cold seep.
南海深海冷泉来源 Iocasia fonsfrigidae NS-1。
design: Combine isolate taxonomy, carbohydrate growth tests, fermentation-product measurements and transcript analyses.
结合分离株分类、多糖生长实验、发酵产物测量及转录分析。
finding: NS-1 used multiple tested carbohydrates and produced hydrogen and organic fermentation products, providing a cultivable model of seep carbohydrate processing.
NS-1 利用多种受测碳水化合物，产生氢及有机发酵产物，可作为冷泉多糖加工的可培养模型。
limit: Isolate products do not establish partner uptake or the organism's contribution to natural seep carbon turnover.
分离株产物不能证明其他伙伴的利用或该菌对天然冷泉碳周转的贡献。

title_zh: 南海冷泉沉积物 Psychrosphaera ytuae 新种
scope: Aerobic sediment strain MTZ26T from an SCS cold seep.
南海冷泉好氧沉积物分离株 MTZ26T。
design: Combine physiological and chemical traits with phylogeny and isolate genome analysis.
结合生理、化学特征、系统发育及分离株基因组分析。
finding: The proposed Psychrosphaera ytuae grew from 4–40°C under tested conditions and carried a 3.33-Mb chromosome.
所提出的 Psychrosphaera ytuae 在受测条件下可于 4–40°C 生长，染色体约 3.33 Mb。
limit: Laboratory temperature tolerance does not demonstrate in situ pressure adaptation or environmental abundance.
室内温度耐受不能证明原位压力适应或环境丰度。
variables: 生长范围与基因组性质

title_zh: 冷泉沉积物 Bacillus fonticola 新种与培养特征
scope: Sediment strain CS13T from an SCS deep-sea seep.
南海深海冷泉沉积物分离株 CS13T。
design: Compare 16S phylogeny, growth ranges and cellular chemistry.
比较 16S 系统发育、生长范围与细胞化学。
finding: Phenotypic and phylogenetic evidence supported Bacillus fonticola; tested growth occurred at 16–37°C and 0–8% NaCl.
表型和系统发育证据支持 Bacillus fonticola；受测生长范围为 16–37°C 和 0–8% NaCl。
limit: Culture-range observations cannot be used as ambient seep temperature/salinity or as evidence of ecological dominance.
培养范围不能作为冷泉环境温盐条件，也不能证明生态优势。

title_zh: 神狐沉积物地球化学剖面及未检出经典 ANME 时的潜在甲烷转化
type: 岩芯调查与甲烷过程培养
scope: Two Shenhu cores above the sulfate–methane transition zone.
硫酸盐–甲烷转换带上方两支神狐岩芯。
design: Combine geochemical profiles, high-throughput community sequencing and AOM/methanogenesis incubations.
结合地球化学剖面、高通量群落测序及 AOM／产甲烷培养。
finding: Incubations showed methane oxidation and production despite no detected classical ANME sequences in the sampled sediments.
尽管受测沉积物中未检出经典 ANME 序列，培养体系仍出现甲烷氧化与产生。
limit: A non-detection is method dependent; the responsible organisms were unresolved and cannot be assigned to Bathyarchaeota from abundance alone.
未检出受方法影响；责任微生物尚未确定，不能仅依据丰度归因于 Bathyarchaeota。
variables: potential methane transformations and community profiles
潜在甲烷转化与群落剖面

title_zh: 持续甲烷释放装置构建南海深海生物群落
scope: Methane-seeping device on the SCS seafloor at approximately 1,000-m depth.
南海约 1,000 m 海床持续释放甲烷的装置。
design: Deploy a methane biocoenosis generator and observe microbial and animal colonization.
部署甲烷生物群落发生装置，观测微生物与动物定殖。
finding: Bacteria and archaea colonized before observed jellyfish and amphipods; viruses were also detected in the constructed community.
观测到细菌与古菌先于水母和端足类定殖，构建群落中也检出病毒。
limit: Colonization succession does not directly trace electron or carbon transfer through all organisms or reproduce all natural seep conditions.
定殖演替不能直接追踪所有生物间的电子或碳转移，也不能复制全部天然冷泉条件。
variables: 微生物与动物定殖顺序

title_zh: 海马贻贝与蛤鳃细菌组成及标记基因功能预测
scope: Gigantidas haimaensis and Archivesica marissinica from Haima.
海马 Gigantidas haimaensis 与 Archivesica marissinica。
design: Compare gill 16S communities and FAPROTAX/PICRUSt inferred functions.
比较鳃 16S 群落及 FAPROTAX／PICRUSt 推断功能。
finding: Both hosts were dominated by Gammaproteobacteria but differed in bacterial diversity and composition, with distinct predicted functional profiles.
两个宿主均以 Gammaproteobacteria 为主，但细菌多样性、组成及预测功能不同。
limit: 16S-derived function prediction is not a metagenome, transcriptome or demonstrated chemoautotrophic nutritional pathway.
16S 功能预测并非宏基因组、转录组或已证实的化能自养营养途径。
variables: 鳃 16S 组成与预测功能

title_zh: 台湾西南冷泉邻近沉积物氢营养型 Methanofollis fontis
type: 产甲烷古菌分离与分类
scope: FWC-SCC2T from station C5-6 near Four-Way Closure Ridge seep.
四方封闭海脊冷泉邻近 C5-6 站位分离株 FWC-SCC2T。
time: R/V Ocean Researcher III cruise ORIII-1900 in 2015; article within the publication window.
2015 年 Ocean Researcher III 航次 ORIII-1900；论文发表于要求的时间范围内。
design: Test methanogenic substrates and compare physiology, 16S and genome similarity.
测试产甲烷底物，比较生理、16S 与基因组相似度。
finding: The proposed Methanofollis fontis used formate or H2/CO2, whereas tested acetate, alcohol and methylamine substrates did not support methanogenesis.
所提出的 Methanofollis fontis 可利用甲酸或 H2／CO2，而受测乙酸、醇类及甲胺未支持产甲烷。
limit: A mesophilic isolate from nearby sediment cannot establish methane production at the active vent or its quantitative field contribution.
邻近沉积物中分离的中温菌不能确定活跃泉口产甲烷或其定量现场贡献。

title_zh: 南海冷泉与海槽沉积物氮依赖甲烷氧化的宏基因组潜力
type: 甲烷途径宏基因组比较
scope: Site F, Haima and Xisha trough reduced sediments.
F 站位、海马与西沙海槽还原沉积物。
design: Compare microbial taxa and methane/nitrogen pathway genes across habitats.
跨生境比较微生物类群及甲烷／氮途径基因。
finding: Methylomirabilis/Methanoperedens signals and related genes supported potential nitrate/nitrite-linked methane oxidation in some sampled habitats.
Methylomirabilis／Methanoperedens 信号及相关基因支持部分受测生境可能具有硝酸盐／亚硝酸盐耦合甲烷氧化。
limit: This study inferred potential from metagenomes; isotope-rate measurements are required to establish pathway contributions to methane removal.
研究从宏基因组推断潜力；需同位素速率测量才能确定各途径对甲烷去除的贡献。
variables: 甲烷／氮基因与分类信号

title_zh: 福尔摩沙冷泉 Nitrincola iocasae 新种的分类
scope: Facultatively anaerobic KXZD1103T from Formosa Ridge sediment.
福尔摩沙海脊沉积物兼性厌氧分离株 KXZD1103T。
design: Combine physiology, 16S phylogeny, genome sequencing and relatedness comparisons.
结合生理、16S 系统发育、基因组测序及亲缘比较。
finding: A 4.17-Mb genome and polyphasic evidence supported Nitrincola iocasae as a distinct species.
4.17 Mb 基因组及多相证据支持 Nitrincola iocasae 为独立新种。
limit: Genus identity does not demonstrate nitrification, denitrification or a community-wide nitrogen-cycling role.
属级名称不能证明硝化、反硝化或对群落氮循环的作用。
variables: 分离株生理与基因组相似度

title_zh: 冷泉碳酸盐磷形态及微纳尺度分布
scope: Three SCS/East China Sea deep-sea seep carbonate sites.
南海／东海三个深海冷泉碳酸盐站位。
design: Measure phosphorus fractions and map P, Ca, C and Fe distributions with NanoSIMS/SEM.
测量磷组分，并利用 NanoSIMS／SEM 映射 P、Ca、C、Fe 分布。
finding: Calcium-bound P was the largest fraction; spatial and elemental associations supported multiple mineral and organic P retention pathways.
钙结合磷占最大比例；空间与元素关联支持多种矿物和有机磷保留途径。
limit: P–Fe covariation does not itself prove iron-dependent AOM as the dissolved-P source or quantify P flux.
P–Fe 共变本身不能证明铁依赖 AOM 为溶解磷来源，也不能量化磷通量。

title_zh: 冷泉 Erythrobacter 的硫代硫酸盐氧化与零价硫途径
scope: SCS cold-seep isolate Erythrobacter flavus 21-3.
南海冷泉分离株 Erythrobacter flavus 21-3。
design: Combine sulfur-product identification, proteomics, genetic tests and intermediate stoichiometry.
结合硫产物鉴定、蛋白组、遗传检验及中间体化学计量。
finding: The tested bacterium converted thiosulfate to zero-valent sulfur through TsdA/SoxB-associated steps, with Sdo proteins involved in further oxidation.
受测菌经 TsdA／SoxB 相关步骤将硫代硫酸盐转为零价硫，Sdo 蛋白参与后续氧化。
limit: Homolog distributions indicate possible capacity but cannot quantify this pathway's natural or global sulfur contribution.
同源基因分布提示可能能力，却不能量化该途径对天然或全球硫循环的贡献。
variables: sulfur intermediates and gene perturbation effects
硫中间体与基因干预效应

title_zh: 福尔摩沙冷泉界面 Sulfurovum 优势群落及基因组潜力
type: 界面扩增子与基因组重建
scope: Formosa near-seep water, surface sediment and Shinkaia gills.
福尔摩沙近泉水体、表层沉积物及 Shinkaia 鳃。
design: Combine short/full-length 16S amplicons and metagenomic binning across interface samples.
结合界面样品短／全长 16S 扩增子与宏基因组分箱。
finding: Sulfurovum dominated sampled interface communities; a reconstructed genome supported rTCA carbon fixation, sulfur oxidation and nitrate-utilization potential.
Sulfurovum 在受测界面群落占优势；重建基因组支持 rTCA 碳固定、硫氧化及硝酸盐利用潜力。
limit: A dominant marker lineage is not a cultured species or a demonstrated carbon/sulfur/nitrogen process rate.
优势标记谱系并非已培养物种，也不能代表已验证的碳／硫／氮过程速率。
variables: Sulfurovum marker abundance and MAG pathways
Sulfurovum 标记丰度与 MAG 途径

title_zh: 蛟龙冷泉表层沉积物原核微生物的垂向分布
type: 表层岩芯标记与宏基因组调查
scope: Jiaolong sediments, comparing 0–6 and 8–14 cm layers.
蛟龙沉积物，比较 0–6 与 8–14 cm 层。
design: Pair 16S pyrosequencing with methane/sulfur/nitrate functional genes in metagenomes.
结合 16S 焦磷酸测序与宏基因组甲烷／硫／硝酸盐功能基因。
finding: Surface layers favored sulfur oxidizers and ANME-1, whereas deeper layers favored sulfate reducers and ANME-1/2; sulfur/nitrate genes covaried near the surface.
表层偏富集硫氧化菌和 ANME-1，深层偏富集硫酸盐还原菌及 ANME-1／2；表层硫／硝酸盐基因共变。
limit: Gene co-distribution does not directly establish electron-acceptor coupling or partner-specific syntrophy.
基因共同分布不能直接确定电子受体耦合或特定伙伴互营。
variables: 群落与功能基因垂向分布

title_zh: 甲烷供应对冷泉贻贝室内暂养共生菌数量的影响
type: 添加甲烷的贻贝暂养实验
scope: SCS Bathymodiolus platifrons and its gill methanotrophic symbionts.
南海 Bathymodiolus platifrons 及其鳃甲烷氧化共生菌。
time: 34-day laboratory maintenance with and without methane.
34 天有甲烷与无甲烷室内暂养。
design: Identify pmoABC, quantify symbiont marker DNA and verify abundance changes by microscopy.
鉴定 pmoABC，定量共生菌标记 DNA，并通过显微观察验证数量变化。
finding: Symbiont abundance declined during maintenance; decline was greater without methane at days 24 and 34.
暂养期间共生菌数量下降，第 24、34 天无甲烷处理的下降更明显。
limit: Marker-DNA abundance and laboratory methane supply do not quantify native symbiont carbon fixation or transfer to the host.
标记 DNA 丰度及室内甲烷供应不能量化天然共生菌碳固定或向宿主转移。
variables: 共生菌标记 DNA 与显微观察

title_zh: 全球冷泉沉积物固氮微生物的系统发育与分解代谢多样性
type: 固氮酶比较宏基因组研究
scope: Eleven global seep regions, including Jiaolong, Haiyang 4, Site F and Haima in the SCS.
全球十一个冷泉区域，包括南海蛟龙、海洋四号、F 站位及海马。
design: Analyze 61 metagenomes, 1,428 MAGs and six metatranscriptomes for nitrogenases and associated energy pathways.
分析 61 个宏基因组、1,428 个 MAG 及六个宏转录组中的固氮酶与相关供能途径。
finding: Nitrogenase genes occurred across more archaeal/bacterial lineages and energy metabolisms than ANME–SRB alone, expanding the genomic catalogue of potential seep diazotrophs.
固氮酶基因分布于 ANME–SRB 之外更多古菌／细菌谱系及供能代谢，扩展了冷泉潜在固氮者的基因组目录。
limit: Gene/transcript evidence does not establish fixation rates for every lineage or a quantitative global nitrogen budget.
基因／转录证据不能确定各谱系的固氮速率或全球氮收支。
variables: 固氮酶系统发育与途径目录
locator: Abstract; Metagenomic datasets for deep-sea cold seep sediments; Introduction describing dataset composition.
摘要；Metagenomic datasets for deep-sea cold seep sediments；引言中的数据集组成。

title_zh: 南海冷泉与海山 DNA／RNA 病毒多样性及有机质代谢基因表达
type: DNA／RNA 病毒组与宏转录组研究
scope: Four SCS locations: declining seep, distant reference, nascent seep and seamount; uppermost 1-cm sediment.
南海四个位置：衰退冷泉、远处对照、新生冷泉及海山；最表层 1 cm 沉积物。
time: ROV Faxian sampling in July 2022; three independent samples per site.
2022 年 7 月 Faxian ROV 采样；各站位三个独立样品。
design: Combine purified viral fractions, DNA/RNA viromes, metagenomes and metatranscriptomes across contrasting habitats.
跨不同生境结合纯化病毒组分、DNA／RNA 病毒组、宏基因组及宏转录组。
finding: Nascent-seep viral communities differed from other habitats, including more RNA/temperate-virus signals; viral metabolic genes showed transcription consistent with possible organic-matter functions.
新生冷泉病毒群落不同于其他生境，包括更多 RNA／温和病毒信号；病毒代谢基因转录支持可能参与有机质功能。
limit: RNA detection and gene expression do not quantify infection rates or community carbon turnover; location and habitat effects overlap.
RNA 检出和基因表达不能量化感染速率或群落碳周转；位置与生境效应重叠。
variables: DNA/RNA viral diversity and gene expression
DNA／RNA 病毒多样性与基因表达
locator: Abstract; Sample collection and total organic carbon measurement; Results on the four-site comparison.
摘要；Sample collection and total organic carbon measurement；四站位比较结果。

title_zh: F 站位贻贝鳃病毒与甲烷氧化共生菌的基因组和转录联系
type: 鳃病毒宏基因组–转录组比较
scope: Nine Site F Gigantidas platifrons individuals, three each from high-, moderate- and low-methane habitats.
F 站位九只 Gigantidas platifrons，高、中、低甲烷生境各三只。
time: ROV Faxian collection in 2019 at 1,119-m depth.
2019 年 Faxian ROV 于 1,119 m 水深采集。
design: Compare gill DNA/RNA viral profiles and infer phage links to methanotrophic symbionts.
比较鳃 DNA／RNA 病毒组成，并推断噬菌体与甲烷氧化共生菌的联系。
finding: Viral profiles differed among methane habitats; expressed phage contigs and shared gene signatures supported candidate associations with the gill symbionts.
病毒组成随甲烷生境不同；表达的噬菌体片段及共有基因特征支持与鳃共生菌存在候选关联。
limit: Computational links and transcripts do not prove productive infection, horizontal transfer or a nutritional effect on the mussel.
计算联系和转录信号不能证明有效感染、水平转移或对贻贝营养的影响。
variables: viral contigs, transcripts and candidate host links
病毒片段、转录与候选宿主联系
locator: Abstract; Sample collection; Relative abundance and composition of viruses of G. platifrons.
摘要；Sample collection；G. platifrons 病毒相对丰度与组成。

title_zh: 南海冷泉上方暮光层不同粒径颗粒相关微生物
type: 原位粒径分级宏基因组调查
scope: Haima/Site F water and SEATS comparison, plus Longqi vent; surface, approximately 200 and 800 m.
海马／F 站位水体与 SEATS 对照，以及龙旂热液站；表层、约 200 及 800 m。
time: SCS sampling in 2018 and vent sampling in 2019.
南海 2018 年、热液站 2019 年采样。
design: Filter approximately 500 L per sample in situ into >50, 10–50 and 1–10 μm particle fractions; analyze metagenomes and carbon chemistry.
每样原位过滤约 500 L，分为 >50、10–50 和 1–10 μm 颗粒组分，分析宏基因组与碳化学。
finding: Particle size and depth were associated with distinct communities and carbohydrate-degradation gene inventories; smaller fractions had lower diversity but more carbon-degradation genes.
粒径与深度对应不同群落及碳水化合物降解基因组成；较小组分多样性较低，但碳降解基因较多。
limit: The sampled fractions are particle-associated, not all free-living microbes; gene inventories cannot quantify particle sinking or remineralization rates.
受测组分为颗粒相关微生物，并非全部游离菌；基因目录不能量化颗粒沉降或再矿化速率。
variables: 粒径分级群落与 CAZyme 组成
locator: Abstract; Sample collection, genomic DNA extraction, and sequencing; Chemical analysis of the seawater samples.
摘要；Sample collection, genomic DNA extraction, and sequencing；海水化学分析。

title_zh: 九龙甲烷礁邻近沉积物未培养微生物的固碳与营养循环潜力
type: 未培养类群基因组与转录研究
scope: A core near Jiulong methane reef at 1,100-m water depth in northern SCS.
南海北部水深 1,100 m 九龙甲烷礁附近一支岩芯。
design: Recover eleven >85%-complete genomes and inspect pathway genes and transcript support.
重建十一个完整度 >85% 的基因组，检查途径基因与转录支持。
finding: Nine phyla included uncultivated archaeal/bacterial lineages with carbon-fixation, organic-substrate use and nutrient-reduction potential; several pathway genes were transcribed.
九个门包括未培养古菌／细菌类群，具有固碳、有机底物利用及营养元素还原潜力；部分途径基因有转录支持。
limit: Transcription is stronger evidence than gene presence but does not establish complete pathway activity, partner exchange or flux.
转录比仅有基因更有支持力，但不能确定完整途径活性、伙伴交换或通量。
variables: MAG 完整度与途径转录

title_zh: 南海及墨西哥湾冷泉碳酸盐保存的微生物遗传记录
scope: SCS and Gulf of Mexico seep carbonates.
南海与墨西哥湾冷泉碳酸盐。
design: Extract carbonate metagenomes, reconstruct marker profiles and recover ten dominant prokaryotic genomes.
提取碳酸盐宏基因组，重建标记组成并获得十个优势原核基因组。
finding: Carbonates preserved ANME and aerobic ammonia-oxidizer signals with community composition distinct from sediment; degradation differed among samples.
碳酸盐保存了 ANME 及好氧氨氧化古菌信号，群落组成不同于沉积物，样品间降解程度不同。
limit: Preserved DNA and genomes do not establish viable cells or current microbial activity in the carbonate.
保存的 DNA 和基因组不能证明碳酸盐中存在活细胞或当前微生物活性。
variables: carbonate DNA composition and recovered genomes
碳酸盐 DNA 组成与重建基因组

title_zh: 海马有机营养微生物的碳氮硫潜力与高压几丁质酶
type: 有机营养微生物基因组与酶实验
scope: Haima sediment microbiomes from active and extinct habitats.
海马活跃及衰亡生境沉积物微生物群落。
design: Analyze 225 nonredundant MAGs and test a candidate chitinase under 15-MPa, 4°C conditions.
分析 225 个非冗余 MAG，并在 15 MPa、4°C 下测试候选几丁质酶。
finding: Many prevalent MAGs encoded organic-substrate use and elemental-cycling genes; a selected chitinase retained structure and showed enhanced activity under the tested pressure/temperature.
多个常见 MAG 编码有机底物利用和元素循环基因；受选几丁质酶在受测压力／温度下保持结构并显示增强活性。
limit: A selected enzyme assay cannot determine community chitin turnover or establish chitin as a long-term carbon/nitrogen store.
单个酶实验不能确定群落几丁质周转，也不能证明几丁质为长期碳／氮储库。
variables: 有机底物基因与几丁质酶活性

title_zh: 海马冷泉砷富集与甲烷、硫循环微生物的联系
type: 砷地球化学与途径基因组学
scope: Haima seep sediments and porewater.
海马冷泉沉积物及孔隙水。
design: Analyze arsenic binding forms, methane-oxidation proxies and arsenic/methane/sulfur genes.
分析砷结合形态、甲烷氧化代理指标及砷／甲烷／硫相关基因。
finding: Seep arsenic enrichment was mainly sulfide bound; methane-related geochemistry and co-occurring arrA/dsrA genes supported linked arsenic–sulfur–methane potential.
冷泉富集砷主要与硫化物结合；甲烷相关地球化学及共现 arrA／dsrA 支持砷–硫–甲烷联系的潜力。
limit: Proxy correlations and genomic co-occurrence do not directly quantify coupled reactions; annual sequestration estimates depend on scaling assumptions.
代理相关性与基因组共现不能直接量化耦合反应；年度固定量估计依赖尺度外推假设。
variables: 砷组分与 arrA／dsrA 基因

title_zh: 海马深岩芯甲烷渗漏层的群落垂向分化
type: 深岩芯地球化学与群落模型
scope: Haima methane-seep sediment profile extending to 290 cm.
深至 290 cm 的海马甲烷渗漏沉积剖面。
design: Compare 21 stratified samples using sediment chemistry, 16S profiles and ecological assembly models.
采用沉积物化学、16S 组成及生态组装模型比较 21 个分层样品。
finding: Microbial diversity declined with sediment depth and composition changed around geochemical transitions, including the approximately 70-cm interval.
微生物多样性随沉积深度降低，群落组成在地球化学转换附近变化，包括约 70 cm 层位。
limit: Assembly-model assignments do not establish causal drivers; gene-based predictions are distinct from measured methane or sulfur rates.
组装模型分配不能确定因果驱动；基于基因的预测不同于测得的甲烷或硫速率。
variables: 垂向多样性及甲烷／硫酸盐剖面
locator: Abstract; Introduction describing 21 stratified samples; Results: Microbial community structure at different depths.
摘要；引言中的 21 个分层样品；结果：不同深度的微生物群落结构。

title_zh: 冷泉动物来源 Curvularia 真菌的基因组引导天然产物发现
type: 基因组引导真菌代谢物研究
scope: Curvularia verruculosa CS-129 from internal Shinkaia crosnieri tissue at an SCS seep.
南海冷泉 Shinkaia crosnieri 内部组织来源 Curvularia verruculosa CS-129。
design: Use genome-guided culture changes, metabolite purification, structure determination and antimicrobial/seedling assays.
结合基因组引导培养条件改变、代谢物纯化、结构解析及抗菌／幼苗实验。
finding: Culture manipulation yielded six previously undescribed cytochalasans; selected compounds showed antimicrobial or seedling-radicle inhibition in laboratory tests.
培养条件改变获得六种此前未描述的细胞松弛素类化合物；部分化合物在室内实验中具有抗菌或幼苗根生长抑制活性。
limit: Culture-induced products and test-organism inhibition do not establish natural production, host protection or ecological function.
培养诱导产物及受测生物抑制不能证明天然产量、宿主保护或生态功能。
variables: 代谢物结构与室内生物活性

title_zh: 冷泉沉木来源 Alternaria 的混源萜类及抗菌活性
type: 沉木来源真菌天然产物
scope: Alternaria alstroemeriae CS-745 isolated from sunken logs at an SCS seep.
南海冷泉沉木来源 Alternaria alstroemeriae CS-745。
design: Purify cultured metabolites, resolve structures/configurations and measure bacterial inhibition.
纯化培养代谢物，解析结构／构型并测量细菌抑制。
finding: Three new meroterpenoids were characterized alongside known congeners; selected products inhibited the tested Klebsiella and resistant Staphylococcus strains.
研究鉴定三种新混源萜及已知同类物；部分产物抑制受测 Klebsiella 与耐药 Staphylococcus 菌株。
limit: In vitro inhibition does not demonstrate antibiotic efficacy in animals or an antimicrobial role in the seep wood habitat.
体外抑制不能证明动物内抗生素疗效或冷泉沉木生境中的抗菌作用。
variables: 混源萜结构与抑制浓度

title_zh: 海马 Aspergillus subversicolor 新酚类及阴性活性筛查
scope: Haima-derived Aspergillus subversicolor CYH-17.
海马来源 Aspergillus subversicolor CYH-17。
design: Determine metabolite structures and test enzyme inhibition, antioxidant and antibacterial activity.
解析代谢物结构，测试酶抑制、抗氧化与抗菌活性。
finding: New phenol derivatives were characterized, but the reported screening found no obvious activity in the tested assays.
研究鉴定新酚类衍生物，但报告的受测实验中未观察到明显活性。
limit: Negative screening applies to the stated assays and concentrations; chemical novelty alone does not imply useful biological activity.
阴性筛查仅适用于所用实验及浓度；化学新颖性本身不能说明有用的生物活性。

title_zh: 海马 Aspergillus fumigatus 的二酮哌嗪衍生物及活性筛查
scope: Haima-derived Aspergillus fumigatus CYH-5 cultures.
海马来源 Aspergillus fumigatus CYH-5 培养物。
design: Isolate a new derivative and known compounds, resolve structures and assay bacterial/enzyme inhibition.
分离一种新衍生物及已知化合物，解析结构并测试细菌／酶抑制。
finding: A new fumitremorgin-related derivative was reported; selected other isolated compounds showed antibacterial or enzyme-inhibitory activity.
研究报告一种新的 fumitremorgin 相关衍生物；部分其他分离化合物具有抗菌或酶抑制活性。
limit: Activity cannot be attributed to the new derivative when demonstrated for other compounds; source origin does not establish field metabolite production.
其他化合物显示的活性不能归于新衍生物；来源信息不能证明现场代谢物生成。
variables: 化合物结构与逐个化合物活性

title_zh: 冷泉 Trichoderma 的脂类、萜类及植物病原真菌抑制
type: 沉积物真菌天然产物实验
scope: Trichoderma lixii R22 from SCS cold-seep sediments.
南海冷泉沉积物来源 Trichoderma lixii R22。
design: Purify lipids/terpenoids, determine structures and test wheat-pathogen inhibition and brine-shrimp toxicity.
纯化脂类／萜类，解析结构并测试小麦病原抑制及卤虫毒性。
finding: Five new lipids and two known terpenoids were identified; selected compounds inhibited the tested wheat-pathogenic fungi.
鉴定五种新脂类及两种已知萜类；部分化合物抑制受测小麦病原真菌。
limit: Laboratory pathogen inhibition does not establish agricultural field efficacy or cold-seep antifungal interactions.
室内病原抑制不能证明农业现场效果或冷泉中的抗真菌相互作用。
variables: 代谢物结构与真菌抑制

title_zh: SAHA 诱导冷泉 Talaromyces 天然产物多样性
type: 化学诱导真菌代谢物研究
scope: Talaromyces minioluteus CS-113 from SCS seep sediments.
南海冷泉沉积物来源 Talaromyces minioluteus CS-113。
design: Apply an HDAC inhibitor during culture, compare LC-MS products, determine structures and test fungal inhibition.
培养时添加 HDAC 抑制剂，比较 LC-MS 产物、解析结构并测试真菌抑制。
finding: SAHA-treated cultures yielded seven new highly oxygenated products and altered metabolite profiles; one selected azaphilone inhibited tested agricultural fungi.
SAHA 处理培养物获得七种新高氧化产物并改变代谢谱；一种受选 azaphilone 抑制受测农业病原真菌。
limit: A metabolite increase does not prove which silent gene cluster was activated or establish natural seep production.
代谢物增加不能证明特定沉默基因簇被激活，也不能确定天然冷泉产量。
variables: 诱导代谢谱与生物活性

title_zh: 冷泉 Talaromyces 生物碱及炎症相关细胞实验
type: 真菌代谢物与细胞实验
scope: SCS seep-derived Talaromyces helicus SCSIO41311.
南海冷泉来源 Talaromyces helicus SCSIO41311。
design: Identify alkaloids and assay nitric-oxide inhibition and selected cytokine responses.
鉴定生物碱，测试一氧化氮抑制及部分细胞因子响应。
finding: A new alkaloid and known compounds were isolated; several products inhibited NO signals, and a selected compound altered LPS-associated cytokine responses.
分离一种新生物碱及已知化合物；部分产物抑制 NO 信号，一种受选化合物改变 LPS 相关细胞因子响应。
limit: Cellular anti-inflammatory signals do not establish clinical benefit or a natural seep microbial function.
细胞层面的抗炎信号不能证明临床收益或天然冷泉微生物功能。
variables: 化合物鉴定与 NO／细胞因子实验

title_zh: 冷泉动物来源 Curvularia 的细胞松弛素衍生物
type: 动物内生真菌化学鉴定
scope: Curvularia verruculosa CS-129 from Shinkaia crosnieri in an SCS seep.
南海冷泉 Shinkaia crosnieri 来源 Curvularia verruculosa CS-129。
design: Isolate cytochalasin derivatives, resolve structures and screen antibacterial activity.
分离细胞松弛素衍生物，解析结构并筛查抗菌活性。
finding: Two new cytochalasin derivatives and a newly reported natural product were characterized from the cultured fungus.
培养真菌中鉴定两种新细胞松弛素衍生物及一种新报道的天然产物。
limit: The inspected abstract lists antibacterial testing but does not support compound-specific potency claims for all products.
所核查摘要列出抗菌测试，但不足以支持全部产物逐个化合物的效力论断。

title_zh: 冷泉 Penicillium 的 verrucosidin 衍生物与抗菌筛查
type: 沉积物真菌代谢物研究
scope: Penicillium polonicum CS-252 from SCS seep sediment at 1,183-m water depth.
水深 1,183 m 南海冷泉沉积物来源 Penicillium polonicum CS-252。
design: Determine metabolite structures/configurations and test inhibition of selected human/aquatic pathogens.
解析代谢物结构／构型，并测试部分人类／水生病原菌抑制。
finding: Six new verrucosidin derivatives were characterized and exhibited activity against selected test pathogens, with reported MICs of 4–32 μg/mL.
鉴定六种新 verrucosidin 衍生物，对部分受测病原菌显示活性，报告 MIC 为 4–32 μg/mL。
limit: Assay-specific MICs do not establish clinical efficacy, broad safety or the products' role in natural seep communities.
特定实验 MIC 不能证明临床疗效、广泛安全性或产物在天然冷泉群落中的作用。

title_zh: 冷泉铠甲虾内生真菌的细胞松弛素类天然产物
type: Endozoic fungal structure and activity study
动物内生真菌结构与活性研究
scope: Curvularia verruculosa CS-129 from internal Shinkaia tissue in the SCS.
南海 Shinkaia 内部组织来源 Curvularia verruculosa CS-129。
design: Purify products, determine structures with spectroscopy/crystallography and measure bacterial or cell-line inhibition.
纯化产物，采用光谱／晶体学解析结构，并测量细菌或细胞系抑制。
finding: New cytochalasin structures included a thioether-linked dimer; selected compounds showed antibacterial or tumor-cell cytotoxicity in vitro.
新细胞松弛素结构包括硫醚连接二聚体；部分化合物在体外显示抗菌或肿瘤细胞毒性。
limit: Different compounds produced different assay effects; the results do not demonstrate host protection or clinical utility.
不同化合物产生不同实验效应；结果不能证明宿主保护或临床用途。
variables: 产物结构与逐个化合物活性

title_zh: 冷泉细菌胞外多糖 EPS364 的结构及细胞活性
scope: Vibrio alginolyticus 364 isolated from an SCS cold seep.
南海冷泉分离株 Vibrio alginolyticus 364。
design: Purify EPS364, characterize sugar composition and test cancer-cell responses with proteomic/qPCR analyses.
纯化 EPS364，鉴定糖组成，并结合蛋白组／定量 PCR 测试癌细胞响应。
finding: A phosphorylated, β-linked polysaccharide was characterized and altered Huh7.5 cell growth, adhesion and apoptosis-related responses.
鉴定一种磷酸化、β 连接多糖，改变 Huh7.5 细胞生长、黏附及凋亡相关响应。
limit: Cell-line effects do not establish a therapeutic benefit or an environmental biofilm function for EPS364.
细胞系效应不能证明治疗收益或 EPS364 的环境生物膜功能。

title_zh: 冷泉 Bacillus N1-1 完整基因组与多糖降解资源
type: 多糖利用分离株基因组
scope: Bacillus N1-1 isolated from an SCS cold seep.
南海冷泉分离株 Bacillus N1-1。
design: Sequence the complete genome of an isolate reported to degrade κ-selenocarrageenan.
测序一株报告可降解 κ-硒卡拉胶分离菌的完整基因组。
finding: The isolate had a 4,497,340-bp circular genome containing candidate polysaccharide-degradation genes.
分离株具有 4,497,340 bp 环状基因组，包含候选多糖降解基因。
limit: Genome annotation does not identify the responsible enzyme or demonstrate natural occurrence and turnover of this modified substrate at seeps.
基因组注释不能识别责任酶，也不能证明该改性底物在冷泉的天然存在及周转。
variables: 基因组结构与多糖基因

title_zh: 琼东南冷泉沉积黑碳的微生物来源及碳汇估计
type: 同位素来源与埋藏重建
scope: Qiongdongnan Basin sediment cores with century-scale seep records.
具有百年尺度冷泉记录的琼东南沉积物岩芯。
design: Combine black-carbon/organic-carbon isotopes, sediment chronology and source/burial scaling.
结合黑碳／有机碳同位素、沉积年代及来源／埋藏尺度估计。
finding: Strong isotope depletion supported a methane-related black-carbon component, estimated at 31–43% of sedimentary black carbon during the reconstructed active period.
显著同位素亏损支持甲烷相关黑碳组分，在重建的活跃期估计占沉积黑碳的 31–43%。
limit: Microbial attribution and global burial estimates depend on endmembers, chronology and seep-area scaling; no global production rate was directly measured.
微生物归因与全球埋藏估计依赖端元、年代及冷泉面积外推；未直接测量全球生产速率。
variables: black-carbon isotopes and reconstructed source fractions
黑碳同位素与重建来源比例

title_zh: 南海及全球冷泉趋磁细菌的分布与代谢潜力
type: 磁学显微与比较基因组
scope: Two active SCS seep sediments plus globally compiled seep metagenomes.
南海两个活跃冷泉沉积物及全球汇编冷泉宏基因组。
design: Combine metagenomics, magnetic measurements and microscopy with genome-scale metabolic reconstruction.
结合宏基因组、磁学测量、显微观察及基因组代谢重建。
finding: Magnetotactic bacterial signals were diverse and widespread in seep datasets; genomes suggested iron/sulfur metabolism potentially associated with methane cycling.
趋磁细菌信号在冷泉数据集中多样且广泛；基因组提示铁／硫代谢可能与甲烷循环相关。
limit: Metabolic reconstructions do not demonstrate methane oxidation by magnetotactic bacteria or quantify their iron/sulfur fluxes.
代谢重建不能证明趋磁细菌氧化甲烷或量化其铁／硫通量。
variables: 磁学／显微观测与 MAG 途径

title_zh: 台湾西南冷泉产甲烷古菌 Methanochimaera 新属新种
type: 产甲烷古菌生理与系统基因组
scope: FWC-SCC4T from Four-Way Closure Ridge sediment offshore southwest Taiwan.
台湾西南四方封闭海脊沉积物分离株 FWC-SCC4T。
design: Test substrates/growth and compare 16S, ribosomal-protein phylogeny and genome relatedness.
测试底物／生长，比较 16S、核糖体蛋白系统发育及基因组亲缘。
finding: The proposed Methanochimaera problematica used H2/CO2 or formate for methane production and required yeast extract under tested culture conditions.
所提出的 Methanochimaera problematica 利用 H2／CO2 或甲酸产甲烷，在受测培养条件下需要酵母提取物。
limit: Laboratory nutrient requirements and mesophilic growth cannot determine native abundance or methane production at low seabed temperature.
室内营养需求及中温生长不能确定天然丰度或低温海床产甲烷。
variables: 产甲烷底物与生长需求

title_zh: 神狐沉积物长期培养中的甲烷转化与群落改变
scope: Shenhu sediment incubations with electron-acceptor treatments.
具有电子受体处理的神狐沉积物培养。
time: Incubations lasting up to 199 days.
最长 199 天培养。
design: Compare methane oxidation/production, sulfate/iron reduction and 16S community shifts during long enrichments.
在长期富集中比较甲烷氧化／产生、硫酸盐／铁还原及 16S 群落变化。
finding: Methane transformations persisted despite undetected classical ANME and declining SEEP-SRB1; community shifts left the responsible unconventional lineages unresolved.
尽管未检出经典 ANME 且 SEEP-SRB1 减少，甲烷转化仍发生；群落变化尚不能确定责任非常规谱系。
limit: Long incubation selects populations; co-enrichment cannot attribute AOM to Bathyarchaeota or prove iron-coupled pathways without targeted validation.
长期培养筛选种群；共同富集不能将 AOM 归于 Bathyarchaeota，或在缺乏针对性验证时证明铁耦合途径。
variables: incubated methane processes and community shifts
培养甲烷过程与群落变化

title_zh: 蛟龙冷泉 ANME 的甲烷与有机碳代谢多样性
scope: Thirteen ANME draft genomes from Jiaolong cold seep.
蛟龙冷泉十三个 ANME 基因组草图。
design: Compare five ANME types using MAG metabolic reconstruction and pathway transcript evidence.
利用 MAG 代谢重建及途径转录证据，比较五类 ANME。
finding: ANME genomes contained methane/carbon pathways and candidate organic-carbon biosynthesis routes, including a transcriptionally supported propanoate pathway.
ANME 基因组包含甲烷／碳途径及候选有机碳合成途径，包括具有转录支持的丙酸途径。
limit: Draft-genome gene absence is not definitive loss; predicted secretion and pathway transcription do not quantify metabolite release.
基因组草图中未见基因不能确定其缺失；预测分泌与途径转录不能量化代谢物释放。

title_zh: 南海冷泉兼性厌氧盐适应菌 Aequorivita iocasae
scope: KX20305T from SCS cold-seep sediment.
南海冷泉沉积物分离株 KX20305T。
design: Compare physiological/chemical traits, 16S and a 3.35-Mb isolate genome.
比较生理／化学特征、16S 及约 3.35 Mb 分离株基因组。
finding: The facultatively anaerobic strain represented Aequorivita iocasae and grew optimally at 3–6% NaCl under tested conditions.
兼性厌氧菌株代表 Aequorivita iocasae，在受测条件下最适 NaCl 为 3–6%。
limit: Culture optima are not measurements of natural seep salinity and do not establish an elemental-cycling role.
培养最适值并非天然冷泉盐度测量，也不能确定元素循环作用。
variables: 生长特征与基因组相似度

title_zh: 冷泉沉积物 Marinobacter fonticola 新种的分类
scope: CS412T isolated from an SCS cold-seep sediment.
南海冷泉沉积物来源 CS412T。
design: Combine 16S phylogeny, growth ranges and cellular chemical characteristics.
结合 16S 系统发育、生长范围及细胞化学特征。
finding: Evidence supported Marinobacter fonticola; tested growth spanned 4–40°C, pH 5–11 and 0–19% NaCl.
证据支持 Marinobacter fonticola；受测生长范围为 4–40°C、pH 5–11 和 0–19% NaCl。
limit: Wide culture tolerance does not establish dominance at seeps or hydrocarbon degradation by this particular species.
广泛培养耐受不能证明其在冷泉占优势或该物种具有烃降解能力。

title_zh: 海马 Asgard 古菌的空间分布与基因组潜力
type: Asgard 空间与基因组重建
scope: Haima seep sediment and marine control sediments.
海马冷泉沉积物与海洋对照沉积物。
design: Recover 48 MAGs across seven Asgard lineages and compare occurrence, defense genes and metabolic inventories.
重建七个 Asgard 谱系的 48 个 MAG，比较出现情况、防御基因与代谢目录。
finding: Asgard genomes were more frequently detected at the seep; candidate Gerdarchaeota encoded Wood–Ljungdahl and organic-substrate processing potential.
Asgard 基因组在冷泉更常检出；候选 Gerdarchaeota 编码 Wood–Ljungdahl 及有机底物加工潜力。
limit: MAG pathways do not establish obligate autotrophy or measured chitin use; CRISPR inventories do not quantify viral protection.
MAG 途径不能确定专性自养或测得几丁质利用；CRISPR 目录不能量化病毒保护。
locator: Publisher abstract: distribution and genomic reconstruction.
出版方摘要：分布与基因组重建。

title_zh: 冷泉与热液 Heimdallarchaeia 的基因组代谢潜力
scope: Four SCS seep sediment samples spanning 0–280 cm and one Western Pacific vent sample.
南海四个冷泉沉积物样品，覆盖 0–280 cm，及一个西太平洋热液样品。
time: R/V Kexue cruise in July 2018.
2018 年 7 月 Kexue 航次。
design: Recover thirteen Heimdallarchaeia MAGs and compare phylogeny, carbon/nutrient genes and oxygen-related functions.
重建十三个 Heimdallarchaeia MAG，比较系统发育、碳／营养基因及氧相关功能。
finding: The MAGs encoded diverse carbon and nitrogen pathways plus oxygen-associated genes, supporting a hypothesis of metabolically flexible Heimdallarchaeia.
MAG 编码多种碳、氮途径及氧相关基因，支持 Heimdallarchaeia 具有代谢灵活性的假说。
limit: Genomic oxygen/pigment genes do not demonstrate microoxic growth, photosynthesis or light-dependent metabolism in the dark seep.
基因组中的氧／色素基因不能证明微氧生长、光合作用或黑暗冷泉中的光依赖代谢。
variables: Heimdallarchaeia MAG 途径与系统发育
locator: Abstract; Phylogenetic status and eukaryotic signatures; Sample collection and processing.
摘要；系统发育与真核特征；Sample collection and processing。

title_zh: 活跃与衰亡冷泉、热液中贻贝宿主与共生菌的响应
type: 跨生态系统宿主–微生物组学
scope: Bathymodiolin mussels from SCS seeps and Southwest Indian Ocean vents, active and extinct habitats.
南海冷泉与西南印度洋热液的 bathymodiolin 贻贝，含活跃及衰亡生境。
design: Compare gill/digestive-gland host transcriptomes, physiological indices and symbiont metagenomes.
比较鳃／消化腺宿主转录组、生理指标及共生菌宏基因组。
finding: Host transcription and symbiont pathway inventories differed by ecosystem and tissue, including stress defense and sulfur/energy metabolism.
宿主转录与共生菌途径组成随生态系统和组织变化，涉及胁迫防御及硫／能量代谢。
limit: Different cruises, environments and hosts may covary; inferred functional compensation does not directly measure carbon transfer or survival benefit.
航次、环境与宿主差异可能共同变化；推断功能补偿不能直接测量碳转移或存活收益。
variables: host stress responses and symbiont pathway genes
宿主胁迫响应与共生菌途径基因

title_zh: 海马深海甲烷气泡羽流的输运与溶解命运
scope: Haima HM01/HMS18 seeps at 1,408–1,522-m seabed depth.
海马 HM01／HMS18 冷泉，海床水深 1,408–1,522 m。
design: Integrate bubble/plume imaging, dissolved-methane profiles, moored currents and numerical simulations.
结合气泡／羽流成像、溶解甲烷剖面、系泊海流及数值模拟。
finding: Observed bubbles reached near the hydrate-stability upper boundary, while dissolved methane decreased by 1–2 orders within 20–40 m above vents.
观测气泡上升至水合物稳定带上界附近，而泉口上方 20–40 m 内溶解甲烷降低 1–2 个数量级。
limit: Dissolved concentration loss is not uniquely microbial oxidation; plume height does not demonstrate surface or atmospheric methane delivery.
溶解浓度降低并不唯一代表微生物氧化；羽流高度不能证明甲烷到达表层或大气。
variables: plume geometry, currents and methane concentrations
羽流几何、海流与甲烷浓度

title_zh: 海马水体与孔隙水甲烷分布及环境关联
scope: Haima seepage and non-seepage water/porewater profiles.
海马渗漏与非渗漏水体／孔隙水剖面。
design: Compare methane distributions with water chemistry and sediment depth, porosity and porewater constituents.
比较甲烷分布与水体化学、沉积深度、孔隙度及孔隙水组分。
finding: Methane distributions varied spatially and vertically and covaried with distinct water-column and sediment geochemical variables.
甲烷分布在空间及垂向变化，并与水体、沉积物中不同地球化学变量共变。
limit: Correlations do not uniquely identify biological consumption; atmospheric-source claims require examination of the gas-exchange calculations.
相关性不能唯一识别生物消耗；大气源论断需进一步检查气体交换计算。

title_zh: 福尔摩沙海脊潮汐与甲烷释放的长期原位观测
scope: Formosa Ridge/Site F seep southwest of Taiwan.
台湾西南福尔摩沙海脊／F 站位冷泉。
design: Monitor gas-emission intensity with ADCP, CTD and current instruments and compare bottom-pressure cycles.
利用 ADCP、CTD 与海流仪监测气体释放强度，并与底压周期比较。
finding: Gas emissions varied through time and closely tracked tidal bottom-pressure fluctuations.
气体释放随时间变化，并与潮汐底压波动密切对应。
limit: A tidal correlation supports a pressure-modulation model but does not prove hydraulic fracturing or uniform behavior across seeps.
潮汐相关性支持压力调制模型，但不能证明水力破裂或各冷泉均具有相同行为。

title_zh: 海马深海溶解甲烷光声与光热传感系统
type: 甲烷传感器标定与现场部署
scope: Sensor tests and three-day deployment near Haima at 1,380-m depth.
传感器测试及海马附近 1,380 m 水深三天部署。
design: Calibrate photoacoustic/thermoelastic spectroscopy with gas extraction and test deep-water dissolved-methane measurements.
标定带气体提取的光声／光热光谱系统，并测试深水溶解甲烷测量。
finding: The compact instrument measured dissolved methane during deployment; laboratory spectrometer tests reported a 0.21-ppm detection limit and approximately four-minute system response.
紧凑仪器在部署中测量溶解甲烷；室内光谱仪测试报告 0.21 ppm 检出限及约四分钟系统响应。
limit: Gas-phase spectrometer ppm cannot be treated as a dissolved-water concentration limit without extraction/calibration conversion.
气相光谱仪 ppm 不能在缺乏提取／标定换算时当作溶解水样浓度检出限。
variables: sensor sensitivity, response and dissolved methane
传感灵敏度、响应与溶解甲烷

title_zh: 海马冷泉上方营养盐及叶绿素与甲烷的关联
scope: Haima overlying euphotic waters and control stations.
海马上覆真光层水体及对照站。
design: Measure methane, nutrients, chlorophyll and hydrography and compare station-level associations.
测量甲烷、营养盐、叶绿素及水文，比较站位关联。
finding: Phosphate and chlorophyll were higher over sampled seeps than controls within an otherwise low-nutrient, low-chlorophyll setting.
在总体低营养、低叶绿素环境中，受测冷泉上方磷酸盐与叶绿素高于对照。
limit: The methane-plume nutrient-delivery mechanism was proposed but not traced; seasonal or hydrographic alternatives remain.
甲烷羽流输送营养机制为提出的解释，未被直接追踪；季节或水文替代解释仍存在。

title_zh: 时间序列视频估计海马与 F 站位冷泉气泡通量
type: 视频泉口气泡通量估计
scope: One Haima vent and three Site F vents.
海马一个泉口与 F 站位三个泉口。
design: Estimate bubble sizes and release rates with image processing and semiautomatic counts.
通过图像处理及半自动计数估计气泡大小与释放速率。
finding: The observed vents differed in bubble-size distributions and inferred gas-volume flux, demonstrating strong vent-scale variability.
受测泉口的气泡粒径分布与推定气体体积通量不同，显示明显泉口尺度差异。
limit: Short observation intervals and gas-volume conversions do not establish annual methane mass flux or the fraction reaching the atmosphere.
短观测时段与气体体积换算不能确定年度甲烷质量通量或到达大气的比例。
variables: bubble diameters, counts and estimated volume flux
气泡直径、数量与估计体积通量

title_zh: 岭头岬浅海渗漏区溶解甲烷及海气交换估计
type: Coastal methane mapping and gas-exchange estimate
近岸甲烷测绘与气体交换估计
scope: 48 stations over 56 km² near Lingtou Promontory/Yinggehai Basin.
岭头岬／莺歌海盆地附近 56 km² 内 48 个站位。
design: Measure surface/bottom methane and carbon isotopes and estimate air–sea flux.
测量表层／底层甲烷及碳同位素，并估计海气通量。
finding: Dissolved methane showed large spatial variation and generally stronger bottom-water enrichment; isotopes supported mixed biogenic and thermogenic sources.
溶解甲烷具有较大空间变化，底层水总体富集更强；同位素支持生物成因与热成因混合来源。
limit: A shallow coastal seep cannot represent deep Haima/Site F transport; air–sea flux is an estimate, not a measured microbial oxidation rate.
浅海近岸渗漏不能代表深海海马／F 站位输运；海气通量为估计，并非微生物氧化速率测量。
variables: methane distribution, isotopes and modeled air–sea flux
甲烷分布、同位素与模型海气通量

title_zh: 琼东南冷泉铁结合有机碳与甲烷相关碳保留
type: 铁结合碳组分／同位素剖面
scope: Qiongdongnan methane-rich and reference sediment cores.
琼东南富甲烷及对照沉积物岩芯。
design: Measure reactive iron-associated OC and isotope-based methane-derived carbon fractions.
测量活性铁结合有机碳及基于同位素的甲烷来源碳比例。
finding: Iron-bound carbon fractions generally decreased in methane-rich sediments, while isotope estimates indicated retention of some methane-related organic carbon.
富甲烷沉积物铁结合碳比例总体降低，同时同位素估计表明部分甲烷相关有机碳被保留。
limit: Fractionation and endmember assumptions constrain source estimates; inventories do not directly determine preservation times or carbon sequestration rates.
分级与端元假设限制来源估计；存量不能直接确定保存时间或碳固定速率。
variables: reactive iron-bound OC and carbon isotopes
活性铁结合有机碳与碳同位素

title_zh: 南海冷泉沉积物 PFAS 的层位分布与定量边界
scope: Forty layers from six northern SCS sediment cores.
南海北部六支岩芯的四十个层位。
design: Analyze 25 target PFASs and distinguish quantified, detected and sub-detection-limit responses.
分析 25 种目标 PFAS，区分可定量、检出与低于检出限响应。
finding: Quantified PFAS sums ranged from 0.13–6.12 ng/g dry weight, with strong station-level compositional heterogeneity.
可定量 PFAS 总和为干重 0.13–6.12 ng/g，站位间组成异质性明显。
limit: Below-LOD responses are not quantified detections; occurrence profiles do not establish toxic effects or chromatographic retention mechanisms.
低于 LOD 的响应不能作为定量检出；赋存剖面不能证明毒性效应或类色谱保留机制。

title_zh: 海马水体、沉积物与贝类中的微塑料赋存
scope: Haima seawater, surface sediment and shellfish.
海马海水、表层沉积物及贝类。
design: Identify/count particles and compare morphology and polymer composition across media.
鉴定／计数颗粒，跨介质比较形态与聚合物组成。
finding: Microplastics occurred in all sampled media, with counts reported in separate units for water, sediment and individual animals.
受测各介质均存在微塑料，水体、沉积物和动物分别采用不同计量单位报告。
limit: Cross-media correlations do not establish transfer direction, ingestion rates or microbial degradation.
跨介质相关性不能确定转移方向、摄入速率或微生物降解。
variables: 颗粒数量、聚合物与形态

title_zh: 南海冷泉砷形态、孔隙水释放与培养响应
scope: SCS seep sediment and porewater.
南海冷泉沉积物与孔隙水。
design: Measure dissolved/solid arsenic, mineral binding and incubation responses associated with sulfate reduction.
测量溶解／固相砷、矿物结合与硫酸盐还原相关培养响应。
finding: Sulfide-bound arsenic dominated the solid pool; porewater iron/arsenic correlations and incubations supported multiple retention/removal processes.
硫化物结合砷主导固相库；孔隙水铁／砷相关性及培养支持多种保留／去除过程。
limit: Adsorption and microbial reactions may overlap; these data do not isolate every reaction's contribution to arsenic removal.
吸附与微生物反应可能重叠；数据未区分每种反应对砷去除的贡献。

title_zh: 福尔摩沙冷泉流体原位拉曼探测与化学梯度
scope: Formosa Ridge vent and fluids within chemosynthetic communities.
福尔摩沙海脊泉口及化能合成群落内部流体。
design: Combine in situ Raman probe measurements, gas chromatography and carbon isotopes.
结合原位拉曼探针、气相色谱及碳同位素。
finding: Vent/fluid measurements detected methane and other reduced gases; community-fluid depth profiles showed sulfate depletion and methane/elemental-sulfur changes.
泉口／流体测量检出甲烷等还原气体；群落流体深度剖面显示硫酸盐消耗及甲烷／单质硫变化。
limit: Geochemical gradients support reaction hypotheses but cannot independently identify organisms, electron-transfer routes or process rates.
地球化学梯度支持反应假说，却不能独立识别微生物、电子传递途径或过程速率。
variables: Raman gas signals and sulfate/sulfur gradients
拉曼气体信号与硫酸盐／硫梯度

title_zh: 海马共生双壳类脂肪酸去饱和酶的功能鉴定
type: 宿主去饱和酶功能实验
scope: Gigantidas haimaensis and Archivesica marissinica from Haima.
海马 Gigantidas haimaensis 与 Archivesica marissinica。
design: Recover host Fad genes from genomes/transcriptomes and test substrate conversion in yeast.
从宿主基因组／转录组获得 Fad 基因，并在酵母中测试底物转化。
finding: Duplicated host desaturases had different substrate specificities, including tested conversion of bacterial-type monounsaturated fatty acid substrates.
重复的宿主去饱和酶具有不同底物特异性，包括对受测细菌型单不饱和脂肪酸底物的转化。
limit: Yeast enzyme function does not quantify fatty-acid transfer from symbionts or lipid synthesis in native host tissues.
酵母中的酶功能不能量化共生菌向宿主脂肪酸转移或天然宿主组织内脂质合成。
variables: Fad 序列与底物特异活性

title_zh: 冷泉 Streptomyces 的 shovelmycin 与 divergolide 类产物
scope: Streptomyces olivaceus HDN22-001 from SCS seep sediment.
南海冷泉沉积物来源 Streptomyces olivaceus HDN22-001。
design: Purify cultured compounds, determine structures and assay radical scavenging/cell-line cytotoxicity.
纯化培养化合物，解析结构并测试自由基清除／细胞系毒性。
