finding: Two new thiodiketopiperazines and an ansamycin derivative were characterized; individual products showed assay-specific antioxidant or cytotoxic signals.
鉴定两种新硫代二酮哌嗪及一种安莎霉素衍生物；单个产物显示实验特异的抗氧化或细胞毒性信号。
limit: DPPH scavenging and cell-line effects do not establish physiological antioxidant benefit or environmental function.
DPPH 清除及细胞系效应不能证明生理抗氧化收益或环境功能。
variables: 化合物结构与实验响应

title_zh: 神狐水合物沉积物有机质来源与深层烃贡献
type: 有机质热解与生物标志物
scope: Hydrate-bearing sediments from the Shenhu area.
神狐含水合物沉积物。
design: Use Rock-Eval pyrolysis and hydrocarbon biomarkers to compare organic-matter and reservoir-source signatures.
采用 Rock-Eval 热解及烃类标志物，比较有机质与储层来源特征。
finding: Biomarkers indicated mixed marine/terrestrial/reworked organic sources and a deep-reservoir hydrocarbon contribution; local deposited organic matter had low generation potential.
标志物指示海洋／陆源／再搬运有机质混合及深层储层烃贡献；当地沉积有机质生烃潜力较低。
limit: A putative methanogen biomarker does not establish active methanogenesis or the fraction of hydrate methane produced locally.
可能的产甲烷菌标志物不能证明活跃产甲烷或当地生成水合物甲烷的比例。
variables: 热解指数与烃类标志物

title_zh: 神狐水合物沉积物生物标志物与降解记录
scope: Shenhu hydrate-bearing cores SH2B and SH7B.
神狐含水合物岩芯 SH2B 与 SH7B。
design: Use GC-MS and comprehensive two-dimensional gas chromatography to characterize sediment biomarkers.
采用 GC-MS 与全二维气相色谱鉴定沉积物标志物。
finding: Unresolved hydrocarbon mixtures and 25-norhopane supported prior biodegradation; the study did not identify a specific methanogen biomarker.
未分辨烃混合物及 25-norhopane 支持既往生物降解；研究未识别特异产甲烷菌标志物。
limit: General hydrocarbon markers cannot identify present methanogens or demonstrate their current methane-production activity.
一般烃标志物不能识别当前产甲烷菌或证明其当前产甲烷活性。

title_zh: 海马西侧沉积物甲烷来源及反应输运估计
scope: Three piston cores west of Haima.
海马西侧三支活塞岩芯。
design: Fit porewater profiles with steady/non-steady reactive-transport models and carbon-isotope mass balance.
以稳态／非稳态反应输运模型及碳同位素质量平衡拟合孔隙水剖面。
finding: Models favored AOM sustained by external free-gas dissolution and variable methane flux histories rather than local methanogenesis alone.
模型倾向于外部游离气溶解支持 AOM 及变化的甲烷通量历史，而非仅由当地产甲烷支持。
limit: Fitted AOM rates and onset ages depend on boundary conditions, chronology and steady-state assumptions; they are not direct incubation measurements.
拟合 AOM 速率与启动年代依赖边界条件、年代及稳态假设，非直接培养测量。
variables: porewater profiles and modeled AOM rates
孔隙水剖面与模型 AOM 速率

title_zh: 海马锰微结核的矿物地球化学与形成推断
type: 微结核矿物／地球化学分析
scope: Manganese-rich Haima active-seep sediments.
海马活跃冷泉富锰沉积物。
design: Extract micronodules and analyze mineral structure, elemental composition, textures and chronometer-derived growth.
提取微结核，分析矿物结构、元素组成、纹理及计时指标推导生长。
finding: Porous Mn-rich micronodules contained phyllomanganates and microbial-like textures, consistent with mixed mineralization processes supplied by seep fluids.
多孔富锰微结核含层状锰矿物及类微生物纹理，与渗漏流体供应的混合矿化过程一致。
limit: Microbial-like textures and growth proxies do not demonstrate manganese-dependent AOM or identify its organisms.
类微生物纹理及生长代理不能证明锰依赖 AOM 或识别责任微生物。
variables: 微结核矿物与元素分布

title_zh: 海马贻贝从原位到室内回收后的肌肉转录变化
type: 回收相关宿主转录序列
scope: Gigantidas haimaensis muscle from Haima, comparing in situ and laboratory samples.
海马 Gigantidas haimaensis 肌肉，比较原位与室内样品。
time: In situ and 0-, 3- and 9-hour laboratory time points.
原位及室内 0、3、9 小时时点。
design: Compare muscle RNA-seq profiles and stress/immune/metabolic pathway enrichment.
比较肌肉 RNA-seq 组成及胁迫／免疫／代谢途径富集。
finding: Recovery was accompanied by extensive host transcriptional differences, including protein-processing and metabolic pathways.
回收伴随广泛宿主转录差异，涉及蛋白加工与代谢途径。
limit: Muscle transcriptomes do not measure gill symbiont activity; handling, pressure and nutrition changes cannot be separated from this series.
肌肉转录组不测量鳃共生菌活性；该序列不能区分操作、压力与营养变化。

title_zh: 东沙水合物钻探区浮游植物、营养盐及季节比较
scope: Dongsha hydrate-drilling water column.
东沙水合物钻探区水柱。
time: May and October 2013 observations; article published in 2018.
2013 年 5 月、10 月观测；论文发表于 2018 年。
design: Compare phytoplankton counts, chlorophyll, nutrients and dissolved methane before and after drilling.
比较钻探前后浮游植物计数、叶绿素、营养盐与溶解甲烷。
finding: Phosphate/chlorophyll increased between surveys while phytoplankton abundance did not change significantly; methane showed no significant direct association in the reported analysis.
调查间磷酸盐／叶绿素增加，浮游植物丰度未显著变化；报告分析未发现甲烷显著直接关联。
limit: Drilling status is confounded with season; proposed plume upwelling does not establish a drilling-caused phytoplankton response.
钻探状态与季节混杂；提出的羽流上升流不能证明钻探导致浮游植物响应。
variables: 浮游植物丰度、营养盐与叶绿素

title_zh: 海马冷泉水合物赋存与流体通道的多尺度证据
type: 地震与 ROV 水合物系统研究
scope: Approximately 400 km² of southern Qiongdongnan Basin and Haima observations.
琼东南盆地南部约 400 km² 及海马观测。
design: Integrate 3D seismic, sub-bottom profiles, bathymetry and ROV observations/sampling.
整合三维地震、浅地层剖面、地形及 ROV 观测／采样。
finding: Gas chimneys, reflectors, pockmarks and ROV hydrate observations supported a connected deep-fluid and shallow seep/hydrate system.
气烟囱、反射层、麻坑及 ROV 水合物观测支持深层流体与浅部冷泉／水合物系统的联系。
limit: Seismic conduits and hydrate occurrence do not quantify microbial communities or methane oxidation efficiency.
地震通道与水合物赋存不能量化微生物群落或甲烷氧化效率。
variables: seismic fluid features and hydrate observations
地震流体特征与水合物观测

title_zh: 神狐白云凹陷新识别气泡羽流及冷泉活动
scope: Baiyun Sag, Shenhu; seep field named Dongfanghong 3 in the study.
神狐白云凹陷；研究将冷泉区命名为 Dongfanghong 3。
design: Detect plume geometry with multibeam echosounding and compare regional geological/oceanographic context.
利用多波束回声探测羽流几何，并比较区域地质／海洋背景。
finding: Ten tilted, flame-shaped plumes were identified, often in pairs, providing evidence of active gas release at the surveyed field.
识别十个倾斜火焰状羽流，常成对出现，为受测区域活跃气体释放提供证据。
limit: Plume detection does not prove that human activity caused reactivation or establish climate forcing or microbial consequences.
羽流检出不能证明人类活动导致再激活，也不能确定气候强迫或微生物后果。

title_zh: 南海水合物–冷泉系统的热流体化学耦合模型
type: 地质–地球化学耦合模型
scope: A South China Sea gas-chimney/hydrate–seep system.
南海一处气烟囱／水合物–冷泉系统。
design: Combine 3D seismic, drilling, geothermal/geochemical observations and numerical modeling.
结合三维地震、钻探、地热／地球化学观测及数值模拟。
finding: The model linked lateral fluid-advection differences to hydrate/free-gas zonation and proposed carbonate-mediated weakening of seep conduits.
模型将横向流体平流差异与水合物／游离气分区联系，并提出碳酸盐沉淀减弱渗漏通道的机制。
limit: Fitted transport parameters and self-sealing feedback are model dependent; microbial precipitation rates were not directly quantified.
拟合输运参数与自封闭反馈依赖模型；未直接量化微生物沉淀速率。
variables: 模型平流与水合物分区

title_zh: 南海北部冷泉系统与水合物赋存的地质综述
scope: Qiongdongnan, Shenhu, Dongsha and Taixinan systems.
琼东南、神狐、东沙及台西南系统。
design: Synthesize seismic, sub-bottom, ROV, drilling and hydrate gas-geochemistry studies.
整合地震、浅地层、ROV、钻探及水合物气体地球化学研究。
finding: The synthesis linked variable seep/hydrate occurrence to deep fluid pathways, including faults, chimneys and diapirs, with mixed gas sources.
综述将不同冷泉／水合物赋存与断层、气烟囱、底辟等深层流体通道联系，并指出混合气源。
limit: Review-level patterns cannot substitute for site-specific microbial sampling, process rates or independently dated seep histories.
综述层面模式不能替代站位微生物采样、过程速率或独立定年的渗漏历史。
variables: 区域冷泉／水合物与流体通道整合

title_zh: 海马贻贝鳃共生、金属积累与组织响应
scope: Gill, mantle and adductor muscle of Haima Gigantidas haimaensis.
海马 Gigantidas haimaensis 的鳃、外套膜与闭壳肌。
design: Compare host RNA, 16S microbiomes, thirteen metals and biochemical indices across tissues.
跨组织比较宿主 RNA、16S 菌群、十三种金属及生化指标。
finding: The gill had methanotroph-dominated bacterial profiles and distinct host immune/stress expression, together with greater metal accumulation and antioxidant responses.
鳃细菌组成以甲烷氧化相关类群为主，宿主免疫／胁迫表达不同，并具有较高金属积累及抗氧化响应。
limit: Tissue associations do not prove symbiont-mediated metal detoxification or functional necessity of the upregulated host genes.
组织关联不能证明共生菌介导金属解毒或上调宿主基因的功能必要性。
variables: tissue transcripts, bacteria and metal concentrations
组织转录、细菌与金属浓度
locator: Publisher Abstract; Discussion describing 16S methods; Data availability.
出版方摘要；讨论中的 16S 方法说明；数据可用性。

title_zh: 海马 Toxicocladosporium 的二酮哌嗪类与化合物特异活性
scope: Toxicocladosporium CYH-18 from Haima sediment at 1,382-m water depth.
水深 1,382 m 海马沉积物来源 Toxicocladosporium CYH-18。
design: Resolve cultured-metabolite structures with NMR/MS and X-ray diffraction and screen bioactivity.
采用 NMR／MS 与 X 射线衍射解析培养代谢物结构，并筛查活性。
finding: A new bridged diketopiperazine and two newly reported natural products were identified; antioxidant/antibacterial activity was observed in selected known co-isolated compounds.
鉴定一种新桥连二酮哌嗪及两种新报道天然产物；抗氧化／抗菌活性见于部分共同分离的已知化合物。
limit: Bioactivity of known compounds cannot be transferred to the new products; culture chemistry does not demonstrate field production.
已知化合物活性不能转用于新产物；培养化学不能证明现场产物生成。
variables: 结构与逐个化合物活性
locator: Publisher Abstract; Introduction identifying sediment depth and source.
出版方摘要；引言中的沉积物水深与来源。

title_zh: 冷泉 Aspergillus nidulans 的 emestrin 类产物及活性
scope: Aspergillus nidulans SD-531 from SCS seep sediment.
南海冷泉沉积物来源 Aspergillus nidulans SD-531。
design: Purify emestrin-type compounds, determine configurations and test antimicrobial/cell-line activity.
纯化 emestrin 类化合物，解析构型并测试抗菌／细胞系活性。
finding: Three new and three known emestrin-type compounds were characterized; activity depended on compound and assay, with the strongest reported cytotoxicity in a known analogue.
鉴定三种新及三种已知 emestrin 类化合物；活性随化合物和实验不同，最强报告细胞毒性来自已知类似物。
limit: Cell-line potency versus a control is not clinical superiority, and does not establish the products' natural ecological function.
与对照比较的细胞系效力不代表临床优越性，也不能确定产物的天然生态功能。
variables: emestrin 结构与实验特异效力
locator: Publisher Abstract: structure and bioactivity results.
出版方摘要：结构与生物活性结果。
